Any attempt to model musical behavior or perception in a general way is filled with difficulties. With regard to models of perception, the question arises of whose perception we are trying to model ― even if we confine ourselves to a particular culture and historical environment. Surely the perception of music varies greatly between listeners of different levels of training; indeed, a large part of music education is devoted to developing and enriching (and therefore likely changing) these listening processes. While this may be true, I am concerned here with fairly basic aspects of perception ― particularly meter and key ― which I believe are relatively consistent across listeners. Anecdotal evidence suggests, for example, that most people are able to ‘‘find the beat’’ in a typical folk song or classical piece. This is not to say that there is complete uniformity in this regard ― there may be occasional disagreements, even among experts, as to how we hear the tonality or meter of a piece. But I believe    .
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
① our devotion to narrowing these differences will emerge② fundamental musical behaviors evolve within communities③ these varied perceptions enrich shared musical experiences④ the commonalities between us far outweigh the differences⑤ diversity rather than uniformity in musical processes counts

🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
That people need other people is hardly news, but for Rousseau this dependence extended far beyond companionship or even love, into the very process of becoming human. Rousseau believed that people are not born but made, every individual a bundle of potentials whose realization requires the active involvement of other people. Self-development is a social process. Self-sufficiency is an impossible fantasy. Much of the time Rousseau wished passionately that it were not: Robinson Crusoe was a favorite book, and he yearned to be free from the pains and uncertainties of social life. But his writings document with extraordinary clarity    . “Our sweetest existence is relative and collective, and our true self is not entirely within us.” And it is kindness ― which Rousseau analyzed under the rubric of pitié, which translates as “pity” but is much closer to “sympathy” as Hume and Smith defined it ― that is the key to this collective existence.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
① the necessity of philosophical study to understand human nature② the development of self-sufficiency through literary works③ the shaping of the individual by his emotional attachments④ the making of the self-reliant man through his struggles⑤ the difficulty of trusting other people wholeheartedly
📢 신호 리마인더

That people need other people is hardly− news, but for Rousseau this dependence extended far beyond companionship or even love, into the very process of becoming human. ①Rousseau believed that people are 핵심not born but made, every individual a bundle of potentials whose realization requires the active involvement of other people. Self-development is a social process. Self-sufficiency is an impossible fantasy. Much of the time Rousseau wished passionately that it were not: Robinson Crusoe was a favorite book, and he yearned to be free from the pains and uncertainties of social life. ②But 주장his writings document with extraordinary clarity    . ③“Our sweetest existence is 인용relative and collective, and our true self is not entirely within us.” ④And it is 결론kindness ― which Rousseau analyzed under the rubric of pitié, which translates as “pity” but is much closer to “sympathy” as Hume and Smith 등호defined it ― that is the key to this collective existence.

  4. 노랑④“And it is kindness ― which Rousseau analyzed under the rubric of pitié, which translates as …”그 집합적 존재의 열쇠는 kindness(연민·공감)이다 — — 빈칸 = 감정적 애착에 의한 개인 형성 = 정답 ③

33빈칸추론 3점평가원 2023학년도 수능 33번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
The entrance to a honeybee colony, often referred to as the dancefloor, is a market place for information about the state of the colony and the environment outside the hive. Studying interactions on the dancefloor provides us with a number of illustrative examples of how individuals changing their own behavior in response to local information    . For example, upon returning to their hive honeybees that have collected water search out a receiver bee to unload their water to within the hive. If this search time is short then the returning bee is more likely to perform a waggle dance to recruit others to the water source. Conversely, if this search time is long then the bee is more likely to give up collecting water. Since receiver bees will only accept water if they require it, either for themselves or to pass on to other bees and brood, this unloading time is correlated with the colony’s overall need of water. Thus the individual water forager’s response to unloading time (up or down) regulates water collection in response to the colony’s need.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
① allow the colony to regulate its workforce② search for water sources by measuring distance③ decrease the colony’s workload when necessary④ divide tasks according to their respective talents⑤ train workers to acquire basic communication patterns

31빈칸추론 2점평가원 2024학년도 6월 31번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
People have always needed to eat, and they always will. Rising emphasis on self-expression values does not put an end to material desires. But prevailing economic orientations are gradually being reshaped. People who work in the knowledge sector continue to seek high salaries, but they place equal or greater emphasis on doing stimulating work and being able to follow their own time schedules. Consumption is becoming progressively less determined by the need for sustenance and the practical use of the goods consumed. People still eat, but a growing component of food’s value is determined by its     aspects. People pay a premium to eat exotic cuisines that provide an interesting experience or that symbolize a distinctive life-style. The publics of postindustrial societies place growing emphasis on “political consumerism,” such as boycotting goods whose production violates ecological or ethical standards. Consumption is less and less a matter of sustenance and more and more a question of life-style ― and choice.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
① quantitative② nonmaterial③ nutritional④ invariable⑤ economic
📢 신호 리마인더

People have always needed to eat, and they always will. Rising emphasis on self-expression values does not put an end to material desires. But prevailing economic orientations are gradually being reshaped. People who work in the knowledge sector continue to seek high salaries, but they place equal or greater emphasis on doing stimulating work and being able to follow their own time schedules. ①Consumption is becoming progressively less 인과determined by the need for 핵심sustenance and the practical use of the goods consumed. ②People still eat, but a growing component of food’s 핵심value is 인과determined by its     aspects. People pay a premium to eat exotic cuisines that provide an interesting experience or that symbolize a distinctive life-style. The publics of postindustrial societies place growing emphasis on “political consumerism,” such as boycotting goods whose production violates ecological or ethical standards. ③Consumption is less and less a matter of sustenance and more and more a question of 결론life-style ― and choice.

  2. 노랑②“People still eat, but a growing component of food’s value is determined by its ______ aspects.”빈칸: 음식 가치의 커지는 부분이 그것의 ______ 측면으로 결정 — — 실용(물질)이 아닌 것으로
  3. 노랑③“Consumption is less and less a matter of sustenance and more and more a question of life-style …”소비는 생존보다 생활양식·선택의 문제 — — 비물질적(경험·정체성) 측면 = 정답 ②

🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
Whatever their differences, scientists and artists begin with the same question: can you and I see the same thing the same way? If so, how? The scientific thinker looks for features of the thing that can be stripped of subjectivity ― ideally, those aspects that can be quantified and whose values will thus never change from one observer to the next. In this way, he arrives at a reality independent of all observers. The artist, on the other hand, relies on the strength of her artistry to effect a marriage between her own subjectivity and that of her readers. To a scientific thinker, this must sound like magical thinking: you’re saying you will imagine something so hard it’ll pop into someone else’s head exactly the way you envision it? The artist has sought the opposite of the scientist’s observer-independent reality. She creates a reality dependent upon observers, indeed a reality in which     in order for it to exist at all.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
① human beings must participate② objectivity should be maintained③ science and art need to harmonize④ readers remain distanced from the arts⑤ she is disengaged from her own subjectivity
📢 신호 리마인더
대조 marriage핵심 opposite결론 dependent예시·부연 ✕ 넘김

32빈칸추론 3점평가원 2026학년도 9월 32번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
Although empathy is widely praised by scholars and public figures, not everyone is an empathy booster. Critics of empathy argue that empathy will not save us from interpersonal and intergroup conflict. In fact, they argue, empathy makes such conflicts worse. These critics maintain that empathy can be exhausting and lead to burnout, insensitivity to suffering, or worse. They argue that we tend to empathize strongly with our in-group and resist empathizing with out-groups, and even enjoy the suffering of out-groups in competitive or threatening contexts. Thus, the prescription for more empathy    . Empathy, they argue, can further entrench conflict and force us into an us vs. them mentality. Finally, even when we try to empathize with others who are dissimilar from us or in unfamiliar contexts, sometimes we are unable to accurately empathize with their experiences, causing further misunderstandings and frustration. Critics of empathy argue that we should give up on empathy and employ other tools in pursuit of social harmony, e.g., rational compassion or moral emotions like fear, anger, and shame.

형광펜 3색🟡 정답 핵심무조건 읽기🟩 주제·배경화제만 파악 · 근거 아님⬜ 예시·부연넘겨도 됨반복어 = 신호어 없이 자리·반복어·정의로 잡는 노랑관계어 = 인과·등호·대조·비교 논리 신호 (PART 0 구문 사전)긍정＋ 부정− = ±어휘 (PART 0 ± 사전)
Although empathy is widely praised by scholars and public figures, not everyone is an empathy booster. Critics of empathy argue that empathy will not save us from interpersonal and intergroup conflict. ①In fact, they argue, empathy makes such conflicts 핵심worse. These critics maintain that empathy can be exhausting and 인과lead to burnout, insensitivity to suffering−, or worse. They argue that we tend to empathize strongly with our in-group and resist empathizing with out-groups, and even enjoy the suffering− of out-groups in competitive or threatening contexts. ②결론Thus, the prescription for more empathy    . ③Empathy, they argue, can further 핵심entrench conflict and force us into an us vs. them mentality. Finally, even when we try to empathize with others who are dissimilar from us or in unfamiliar contexts, sometimes we are unable to accurately empathize with their experiences, causing further misunderstandings and frustration. Critics of empathy argue that we should give up on empathy and employ other tools in pursuit of social harmony, e.g., rational compassion or moral emotions like fear, anger, and shame.
🟡 노란색 문장만으로 정답이 나오는 과정 (노랑①②③ = 위 지문에 같은 번호로 칠한 노랑 문장)
  1. 노랑①“In fact, they argue, empathy makes such conflicts worse.”비판자들은 공감이 갈등을 더 악화(worse)시킨다고 본다 — — 공감이 갈등을 악화
  2. 노랑②“Thus, the prescription for more empathy ______.”빈칸: 따라서 더 많은 공감이라는 처방은 ______ — — 앞 결론상 '갈등에는 역효과'
  3. 노랑③“Empathy, they argue, can further entrench conflict and force us into an us vs. them mentality.”공감은 갈등을 더욱 확립하고 우리 대 그들 사고로 몰아넣는다 — — 공감은 갈등에 역효과 = 정답 ③
→ 더 많은 공감 처방은 갈등 상황에서 종종 역효과 = ③
소진·내집단 편향 열거(회색)는 '공감=갈등 악화' 논지의 근거 나열.
패러프레이즈 empathy makes such conflicts worse · empathy can further entrench conflict → is often counterproductive in cases of conflict ✓ / 복사 함정 conflicts
①underestimates the invisible conflicts possible within a group집단 내부에서 가능한 보이지 않는 갈등을 과소평가한다✘ 표면어휘
②is triggered by the need for solutions to emotional conflicts감정적 갈등에 대한 해결책의 필요에 의해 촉발된다✘ 없음

⑤raises questions about negative attitudes toward social disharmony사회적 부조화에 대한 부정적 태도에 의문을 제기한다✘ 없음

🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
We are famously living in the era of the attention economy, where the largest and most profitable businesses in the world are those that consume my attention. The advertising industry is literally dedicated to capturing the conscious hours of my life and selling them to someone else. It might seem magical that so many exciting and useful software systems are available to use for free, but it is now conventional wisdom that if you can’t see who is paying for something that appears to be free, then    . Our creative engagement with other people is mediated by AI-based recommendation systems that are designed to trap our attention through the process that Nick Seaver calls captology, keeping us attending to work sold by one company rather than another, replacing the freedom of personal exploration with algorithm-generated playlists or even algorithm-generated art.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
① all of your attention has already been spent② the real product being sold is you③ your privacy is being violated④ the public may be sponsoring you⑤ you owe the benefits to your friend AI
📢 신호 리마인더
핵심 consume my attention근거 selling them to someone else역접 but
✅ 셀프 체크
  • 근거 신호 문장을 찾아 칠했나?
  • 예시·양보절은 회색으로 넘겼나?
  • 지문 단어 그대로 쓴 선지부터 지웠나?
✍️ 내 풀이
걸린 시간
내가 고른 답

💡 빈칸추론 팁
역접·한정 문장 추상화 / 지문어 복사 선지 = 함정
🔁재진술 연결 문제추가 문제 재진술 2개 찾기
핵심 소재·주장(A)은 주어져 있다. 지문에서 그것을 다른 말로 바꾼 표현을 나온 만큼 A′→A″…로 찾아 잇는다. 실제 재진술만 — 없으면 잇지 않는다.

🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
We know that animals have evolved a variety of patterns to manipulate the perceptions of their predators to afford themselves a modicum of safety. Greater Bower birds utilize     in the mating domain. Males construct a bower; its function is to provide an arena in which males display to females standing in an avenue that leads up to the bower. The males decorate the avenue with a variety of objects, such as stones and shells. But they do not do so in a chaotic manner. The larger objects are placed closer to the bower and the smaller objects farther away. This creates a forced perspective the opposite of the Cinderella Castle; the bower appears smaller than it actually is. Endler and his colleagues suggested that the male courting in the bower now appears larger and thus more attractive to the female. Data on male mating success collected in the wild supports their hypothesis.

① genetic variations② perceptual biases③ vocal attractiveness④ decorating skills⑤ locational advantages

  2. 노랑②“Greater Bower birds utilize ______ in the mating domain.”바우어새는 짝짓기 영역에서 ______을 이용한다(빈칸) — — 첫 문장의 ‘지각 조작’이 짝짓기로 확장
  3. 노랑③“This creates a forced perspective the opposite of the Cinderella Castle; the bower appears …”물체 배치로 강제 원근법을 만들어 bower가 실제보다 작아 보인다(수컷은 커 보임) — — 착시=지각 편향 이용 = 정답 ②
→ 바우어새가 이용하는 것 = 상대의 착시, 즉 ‘지각 편향’ = ②

②perceptual biases지각적 편향✔ 근거

1
We know that animals have evolved a variety of patterns / to manipulate the perceptions of their predators / to afford themselves a modicum of safety.
우리는 동물이 다양한 패턴을 진화시켜 왔음을 안다 / 포식자의 지각을 조작하기 위해 / 스스로에게 약간의 안전을 마련하려고. ← 근거: 지각 조작이 상위 개념
2
Greater Bower birds utilize ______ / in the mating domain.
큰바우어새는 ______을 이용한다 / 짝짓기 영역에서. ← 빈칸 문장: 바우어새가 이용하는 것
3
This creates a forced perspective the opposite of the Cinderella Castle; / the bower appears smaller than it actually is.
이것은 신데렐라 성과 반대되는 강제 원근법을 만든다; / bower가 실제보다 더 작아 보인다. ← 근거: 착시(강제 원근법)로 지각을 속임
②정답 상대의 지각 편향(착시)을 이용 · ①유전적 변이(없음) ③발성 매력(없음) ④장식 기술(표면어) ⑤위치적 이점(표면어)

핵심(A)바우어새는 포식자 상대의 지각 조작 전략처럼, 짝짓기에서 착시(지각 편향)를 이용한다
같은 소재 A가 A→A′→A″→A‴로 표현만 바뀌며 되풀이 → 마지막이 정답 선지

🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
The critic who wants to write about literature from a formalist perspective must first be a close and careful reader who examines all the elements of a text individually and questions how they come together to create a work of art. Such a reader, who respects the autonomy of a work, achieves an understanding of it by    . Instead of examining historical periods, author biographies, or literary styles, for example, he or she will approach a text with the assumption that it is a self-contained entity and that he or she is looking for the governing principles that allow the text to reveal itself. For example, the correspondences between the characters in James Joyce’s short story “Araby” and the people he knew personally may be interesting, but for the formalist they are less relevant to understanding how the story creates meaning than are other kinds of information that the story contains within itself.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
① putting himself or herself both inside and outside it② finding a middle ground between it and the world③ searching for historical realities revealed within it④ looking inside it, not outside it or beyond it⑤ exploring its characters’ cultural relevance

🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
Manufacturers design their innovation processes around the way they think the process works. The vast majority of manufacturers still think that product development and service development are always done by manufacturers, and that their job is always to find a need and fill it rather than to sometimes find and commercialize an innovation that    . Accordingly, manufacturers have set up market-research departments to explore the needs of users in the target market, product-development groups to think up suitable products to address those needs, and so forth. The needs and prototype solutions of lead users ― if encountered at all ― are typically rejected as outliers of no interest. Indeed, when lead users’ innovations do enter a firm’s product line ― and they have been shown to be the actual source of many major innovations for many firms ― they typically arrive with a lag and by an unusual and unsystematic route.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
① lead users tended to overlook② lead users have already developed③ lead users encountered in the market④ other firms frequently put into use⑤ both users and firms have valued

대조 rather than신호 rejected반전 actual source

31빈칸추론 평가원 2025학년도 수능 31번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
Literature can be helpful in the language learning process because of the     it fosters in readers. Core language teaching materials must concentrate on how a language operates both as a rule-based system and as a sociosemantic system. Very often, the process of learning is essentially analytic, piecemeal, and, at the level of the personality, fairly superficial. Engaging imaginatively with literature enables learners to shift the focus of their attention beyond the more mechanical aspects of the foreign language system. When a novel, play or short story is explored over a period of time, the result is that the reader begins to ‘inhabit’ the text. He or she is drawn into the book. Pinpointing what individual words or phrases may mean becomes less important than pursuing the development of the story. The reader is eager to find out what happens as events unfold; he or she feels close to certain characters and shares their emotional responses. The language becomes ‘transparent’ ― the fiction draws the whole person into its own world.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
Centralized, formal rules can    . The rules of baseball don’t just regulate the behavior of the players; they determine the behavior that constitutes playing the game. Rules do not prevent people from playing baseball; they create the very practice that allows people to play baseball. A score of music imposes rules, but it also creates a pattern of conduct that enables people to produce music. Legal rules that enable the formation of corporations, that enable the use of wills and trusts, that create negotiable instruments, and that establish the practice of contracting all make practices that create new opportunities for individuals. And we have legal rules that establish roles individuals play within the legal system, such as judges, trustees, partners, and guardians. True, the legal rules that establish these roles constrain the behavior of individuals who occupy them, but rules also create the roles themselves. Without them an individual would not have the opportunity to occupy the role.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
① categorize one’s patterns of conduct in legal and productive ways② lead people to reevaluate their roles and practices in a society③ encourage new ways of thinking which promote creative ideas④ reinforce one’s behavior within legal and established contexts⑤ facilitate productive activity by establishing roles and practices

핵심 Centralized, formal rules핵심 create the very practice역접 but rules also create the roles예시·부연 ✕ 넘김

34빈칸추론 3점평가원 2026학년도 6월 34번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
One word is inextricably associated with geography: where. That is because geography starts from the premise that it matters where something takes place on Earth’s surface. The key questions are not simply “where” questions, though; they are “why there” and “so what” questions. Getting to such questions means taking spatial arrangements, variations, and interconnections seriously. Engaging in even the simplest day-to-day activity requires some appreciation of spatial circumstances ― where to find food and services, how to get to work places, and the like. Moving up in scale, without some awareness of    , it is difficult to make reasoned business or policy judgments, make sense of events, or grasp some of the basic forces shaping life on the planet. Locating a new store or public service requires taking into consideration population distributions, the location of roads and utilities, socio-economic patterns, and more. Understanding why and where migration happens requires consideration of the political organization of territory, the spatial consequences of discrimination, socio-economic patterns, and the layout of the physical environment.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
① why cross-cultural conflicts will increase② how phenomena are arranged on Earth’s surface③ when the Earth’s natural resources will be exhausted④ which places on Earth are damaged by climate change⑤ who has the authority to make decisions about territories

34빈칸추론 3점평가원 2023학년도 수능 34번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
We understand that the segregation of our consciousness into present, past, and future is both a fiction and an oddly self-referential framework; your present was part of your mother’s future, and your children’s past will be in part your present. Nothing is generally wrong with structuring our consciousness of time in this conventional manner, and it often works well enough. In the case of climate change, however, the sharp division of time into past, present, and future has been desperately misleading and has, most importantly, hidden from view the extent of the responsibility of those of us alive now. The narrowing of our consciousness of time smooths the way to divorcing ourselves from responsibility for developments in the past and the future with which our lives are in fact deeply intertwined. In the climate case, it is not that    . It is that the realities are obscured from view by the partitioning of time, and so questions of responsibility toward the past and future do not arise naturally.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
① all our efforts prove to be effective and are thus encouraged② sufficient scientific evidence has been provided to us③ future concerns are more urgent than present needs④ our ancestors maintained a different frame of time⑤ we face the facts but then deny our responsibility
📢 신호 리마인더
역접 however대조 not that핵심 obscured
✅ 셀프 체크
  • 근거 신호 문장을 찾아 칠했나?
  • 예시·양보절은 회색으로 넘겼나?
  • 지문 단어 그대로 쓴 선지부터 지웠나?

  2. 노랑②“In the climate case, it is not that ______.”‘…한 것이 아니다(it is not that ______)’ — 부정될 상황이 빈칸 — — 뒤 문장과 대조되는 '틀린 설명'이 빈칸에 들어감

34빈칸추론STEP 3 · 해석 (직독직해)🟡문장·선지만
🟡 무조건 읽는 문장 — 슬래시(/)로 끊어 읽기 · 영↔한 대응
1
In the case of climate change, however, / the sharp division of time into past, present, and future has been desperately misleading / and has, most importantly, hidden from view the extent of the responsibility of those of us alive now.
그러나 기후변화의 경우, / 시간을 과거·현재·미래로 날카롭게 나눔은 지독히 오해를 낳아 왔고 / 무엇보다, 지금 살아 있는 우리의 책임 범위를 시야에서 가려 왔다. ← 근거: 시간 분할이 책임을 가림
2
In the climate case, / it is not that ______.
기후 사례에서, / 그것은 ______ 것이 아니다. ← 빈칸 문장: 부정되는 설명
3
It is that the realities are obscured from view by the partitioning of time, / and so questions of responsibility toward the past and future do not arise naturally.
사실은 현실이 시간의 분할에 의해 시야에서 흐려진다는 것이고, / 그래서 과거와 미래에 대한 책임의 물음이 자연히 생기지 않는다. ← 근거: 현실 자체가 가려짐(직시가 아님)
⑤정답 사실을 직시하고도 책임을 부정하는 것이 아니다(사실이 가려짐) · ①노력이 효과적(없음) ②충분한 과학적 증거(없음) ③미래가 더 급함(표면어) ④조상의 다른 시간 틀(없음)
🔁재진술 지도 재진술 연결 문제 · 정답 패러프레이징
핵심(A)시간을 나누는 사고가 현실을 가려, 우리는 사실을 직시하고 부정하는 게 아니라 아예 책임 물음을 못 떠올린다
같은 소재 A가 A→A′→A″→A‴로 표현만 바뀌며 되풀이 → 마지막이 정답 선지
Athe sharp division of time ... hidden from view the extent of the responsibility시간 분할이 책임을 시야에서 가림

A′′↓부연the realities are obscured from view ... responsibility ... do not arise naturally현실이 가려져 책임 물음이 안 생김
정답‘현실이 가려짐’과 대조되는 부정 대상 = ‘직시하고도 책임 부정’ = ⑤

31빈칸추론 평가원 2024학년도 9월 31번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
In the post-World War II years after 1945, unparalleled economic growth fueled a building boom and a massive migration from the central cities to the new suburban areas. The suburbs were far more dependent on the automobile, signaling the shift from primary dependence on public transportation to private cars. Soon this led to the construction of better highways and freeways and the decline and even loss of public transportation. With all of these changes came a     of leisure. As more people owned their own homes, with more space inside and lovely yards outside, their recreation and leisure time was increasingly centered around the home or, at most, the neighborhood. One major activity of this home-based leisure was watching television. No longer did one have to ride the trolly to the theater to watch a movie; similar entertainment was available for free and more conveniently from television.

① downfall② uniformity③ restoration④ privatization⑤ customization

전환 private빈칸 leisure핵심 home예시·부연 ✕ 넘김

  • 지문 단어 그대로 쓴 선지부터 지웠나?

In the post-World War II years after 1945, unparalleled economic growth fueled a building boom and a massive migration from the central cities to the new suburban areas. ①The suburbs were far more dependent on the automobile, signaling the 대체shift from primary dependence on public transportation to 전환private cars. Soon this led to the construction of better highways and freeways and the decline and even loss of public transportation. ②With all of these changes came a     of 빈칸leisure. ③As more people owned their own 핵심homes, with more space inside and lovely yards outside, their recreation and leisure time was increasingly centered around the home or, at most, the neighborhood. One major activity of this home-based leisure was watching television. No longer did one have to ride the trolly to the theater to watch a movie; similar entertainment was available for free and more conveniently from television.
🟡 노란색 문장만으로 정답이 나오는 과정 (노랑①②③ = 위 지문에 같은 번호로 칠한 노랑 문장)
  1. 노랑①“The suburbs were far more dependent on the automobile, signaling the shift from primary …”교외화로 대중교통에서 개인 자동차로 의존이 전환됨 — — 공적(public)에서 사적(private)으로의 이동
  2. 노랑②“With all of these changes came a ______ of leisure.”이 모든 변화와 함께 빈칸 ______ 의 여가가 옴 — — 빈칸 = 여가의 어떤 성격 변화
  3. 노랑③“As more people owned their own homes, with more space inside and lovely yards outside, their …”여가가 점점 집(home)을 중심으로 이루어짐 — — 사적 공간 중심 = 여가의 사유화 = 정답 ④
→ 공공에서 집 중심의 사적 활동으로 = 여가의 사유화(privatization) = ④
회색(도입·TV·극장 부연)은 '공공→사적' 논리의 예시일 뿐.

①downfall쇠퇴, 몰락✘ 표면어휘
②uniformity획일성✘ 없음
③restoration회복, 복원✘ 없음
④privatization사유화✔ 근거
⑤customization맞춤화✘ 없음

Prior to photography,    . While painters have always lifted particular places out of their ‘dwelling’ and transported them elsewhere, paintings were time-consuming to produce, relatively difficult to transport and one-of-a-kind. The multiplication of photographs especially took place with the introduction of the half-tone plate in the 1880s that made possible the mechanical reproduction of photographs in newspapers, periodicals, books and advertisements. Photography became coupled to consumer capitalism and the globe was now offered ‘in limitless quantities, figures, landscapes, events which had not previously been utilised either at all, or only as pictures for one customer’. Light, small and mass-produced photographs became dynamic vehicles for the spatiotemporal circulation of places.

① paintings alone connected with nature② painting was the major form of art③ art held up a mirror to the world④ desire for travel was not strong⑤ places did not travel well

🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
Over the last decade the attention given to how children learn to read has foregrounded the nature of textuality, and of the different, interrelated ways in which readers of all ages make texts mean. ‘Reading’ now applies to a greater number of representational forms than at any time in the past: pictures, maps, screens, design graphics and photographs are all regarded as text. In addition to the innovations made possible in picture books by new printing processes, design features also predominate in other kinds, such as books of poetry and information texts. Thus, reading becomes a more complicated kind of interpretation than it was when children’s attention was focused on the printed text, with sketches or pictures as an adjunct. Children now learn from a picture book that words and illustrations complement and enhance each other. Reading is not simply    . Even in the easiest texts, what a sentence ‘says’ is often not what it means.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
① word recognition② imaginative play③ knowledge acquisition④ image mapping⑤ subjective interpretation

결론 Thus한정 not simply근거 not what it means예시·부연 ✕ 넘김

Over the last decade the attention given to how children learn to read has foregrounded the nature of textuality, and of the different, interrelated ways in which readers of all ages make texts mean. ‘Reading’ now applies to a greater number of representational forms than at any time in the past: pictures, maps, screens, design graphics and photographs are all regarded as text.   1. 노랑①“Thus, reading becomes a more complicated kind of interpretation than it was when children’s …”읽기는 인쇄된 텍스트에 집중하던 때보다 더 복잡한 해석이 된다 — — 핵심은 '읽기 = 복잡한 해석 과정'
  2. 노랑②“Reading is not simply ______.”따라서 읽기는 단순히 ______ 이 아니다 — — 빈칸 = 읽기가 넘어서는 '단순한 것'
  3. 노랑③“Even in the easiest texts, what a sentence ‘says’ is often not what it means.”가장 쉬운 텍스트조차 문장이 '말하는' 것이 의미하는 바가 아니다 — — 즉 글자만 알아보는 것으로 끝나지 않음 → 빈칸 = 단어 인식 = 정답 ①
→ 읽기는 단순한 단어 알아보기가 아니라 의미 해석이다 = 빈칸 = word recognition = ①

There have been psychological studies in which subjects were shown photographs of people’s faces and asked to identify the expression or state of mind evinced. The results are invariably very mixed. In the 17th century the French painter and theorist Charles Le Brun drew a series of faces illustrating the various emotions that painters could be called upon to represent. What is striking about them is that    . What is missing in all this is any setting or context to make the emotion determinate. We must know who this person is, who these other people are, what their relationship is, what is at stake in the scene, and the like. In real life as well as in painting we do not come across just faces; we encounter people in particular situations and our understanding of people cannot somehow be precipitated and held isolated from the social and human circumstances in which they, and we, live and breathe and have our being.

32빈칸추론 평가원 2027학년도 6월 32번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
Speakers don’t always put everything that’s important to them into words. Very often you can understand a speaker’s meaning by observing their nonverbal behaviors such as a change in a vocal tone or volume, eye contact, facial expressions and gestures. As it is easy to misinterpret nonverbal behavior, effective listeners verbally confirm their interpretations of someone’s nonverbal communication. A question as simple as “Do your nods indicate a yes vote?” can make sure that everyone is on the same wavelength. If, as nonverbal research indicates, more than half of a speaker’s meaning is conveyed nonverbally, we are missing a lot of important information if we fail to “listen” to nonverbal behavior. Even Freud suggested that “he that has eyes to see and ears to hear may convince himself that no mortal can keep a secret. If his lips are silent, he chatters with his fingertips; betrayal oozes out of him at every pore.” No wonder it is difficult for most people to     in a face-to-face group discussion.

Fans feel for feeling’s own sake. They make meanings beyond what seems to be on offer. They build identities and experiences, and make artistic creations of their own to share with others. A person can be an individual fan, feeling an “idealized connection with a star, strong feelings of memory and nostalgia,” and engaging in activities like “collecting to develop a sense of self.” But, more often, individual experiences are embedded in social contexts where other people with shared attachments socialize around the object of their affections. Much of the pleasure of fandom    . In their diaries, Bostonians of the 1800s described being part of the crowds at concerts as part of the pleasure of attendance. A compelling argument can be made that what fans love is less the object of their fandom than the attachments to (and differentiations from) one another that those affections afford.

Imagination continues to function when perception is not actively discerning objects, in cases of emotion, disease, and sleep. Emotions dispose one to see the world in a distorted way. A coward’s perceptual disposition is affected by his disposition to experience fear. A lover’s expectations are affected by desire. In such cases, a small similarity between a perceived object and the thing one expects to see can lead to the misidentification of the perceived object as that thing. The coward sees the enemy, while the lover sees the object of desire everywhere. The more affected one is,    . While the central organ of sense normally functions by comparing similarities and differences, emotions dispose one to discern objects inaccurately. The greater the emotional investment, the more biased one’s perception.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
① the more chances one gets to find differences② the less similarity is required for the thing to appear③ the sooner the perceived similarity fades away④ the more easily one can sense the world the way it is⑤ the less slowly different emotions are released
📢 신호 리마인더
핵심 small similarity비례 more affected결론 emotional investment

Imagination continues to function when perception is not actively discerning objects, in cases of emotion, disease, and sleep. Emotions dispose one to see the world in a distorted way. A coward’s perceptual disposition is affected by his disposition to experience fear. A lover’s expectations are affected by desire. ①In such cases, a 핵심small similarity between a perceived object and the thing one expects to see can 인과lead to the misidentification of the perceived object as that thing. Young contemporary artists who employ digital technologies in their practice rarely make reference to computers. For example, Wade Guyton, an abstractionist who uses a word processing program and inkjet printers, does not call himself a computer artist. Moreover, some critics, who admire his work, are little concerned about his extensive use of computers in the art-making process. This is a marked contrast from three decades ago when artists who utilized computers were labeled by critics ― often disapprovingly ― as computer artists. For the present generation of artists, the computer, or more appropriately, the laptop, is one in a collection of integrated, portable digital technologies that link their social and working life. With tablets and cell phones surpassing personal computers in Internet usage, and as slim digital devices resemble nothing like the room-sized mainframes and bulky desktop computers of previous decades, it now appears that the computer artist is finally    .

Because the environment plays a significant role in aiding meaningful internal processes, subjective experience and the environment act as a ‘coupled system.’ This coupled system can be seen as a complete cognitive system of its own. In this manner, subjective experience is extended into the external environment and vice versa; the external environment with its disciplinary objects such as institutional laws and equipment becomes mental institutions that    . A subjectively held belief attains the status of objectivity when the belief is socially shared. That is, even if we are trained as hard-nosed health care rationalists, or no-nonsense bureaucrats, or data-driven scientists, research has shown that our decisions are influenced by various institutional practices. They include bureaucratic structures and procedures, the architectural design of health care institutions, the rules of evidence and the structure of allowable questions in a courtroom trial, the spatial arrangement of kindergartens and supermarkets, and a variety of conventions and practices designed to manipulate our emotions.

31빈칸추론 평가원 2025학년도 9월 31번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
There has been a lot of discussion on why moths are attracted to light. The consensus seems to hold that moths are not so much attracted to lights as they are     by them. The light becomes a sensory overload that disorients the insects and sends them into a holding pattern. A hypothesis called the Mach band theory suggests that moths see a dark area around a light source and head for it to escape the light. Another theory suggests that moths perceive the light coming from a source as a diffuse halo with a dark spot in the center. The moths, attempting to escape the light, fly toward that imagined “portal,” bringing them closer to the source. As they approach the light, their reference point changes and they circle the light hopelessly trying to reach the portal. Everyone is familiar with moths circling their porch lights. Their flight appears to have no purpose, but they are, it is believed, trying to escape the pull of the light.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
① warmed② trapped③ targeted④ protected⑤ rejected
📢 신호 리마인더
대조 not so much핵심 holding pattern결론 escape the pull예시·부연 ✕ 넘김
✅ 셀프 체크

  • 예시·양보절은 회색으로 넘겼나?
  • 지문 단어 그대로 쓴 선지부터 지웠나?

역접·한정 문장 추상화 / 지문어 복사 선지 = 함정
🔁재진술 연결 문제추가 문제 재진술 2개 찾기
핵심 소재·주장(A)은 주어져 있다. 지문에서 그것을 다른 말로 바꾼 표현을 나온 만큼 A′→A″…로 찾아 잇는다. 실제 재진술만 — 없으면 잇지 않는다.

Another theory suggests that moths perceive the light coming from a source as a diffuse halo with a dark spot in the center. The moths, attempting to escape the light, fly toward that imagined “portal,” bringing them closer to the source. As they approach the light, their reference point changes and they circle the light hopelessly trying to reach the portal. 🟡 노란색 문장만으로 정답이 나오는 과정 (노랑①②③ = 위 지문에 같은 번호로 칠한 노랑 문장)
  1. 노랑①“The consensus seems to hold that moths are not so much attracted to lights as they are ______ …”통념은 나방이 빛에 이끌린다기보다 빛에 의해 ______된다고 봄 — — 'not so much A as B' 구조 → 빈칸은 '끌림'과 대비되는 상태
  2. 노랑②“The light becomes a sensory overload that disorients the insects and sends them into a holding …”빛은 감각 과부하가 되어 나방을 방향 상실시키고 정지 패턴(holding pattern)에 빠뜨림 — — 빛에서 벗어나지 못하고 붙잡힘
  3. 노랑③“Their flight appears to have no purpose, but they are, it is believed, trying to escape the …”나방의 비행은 목적 없어 보이지만 실은 빛의 끌림에서 벗어나려(escape the pull) 애씀 — — 벗어나려 해도 못 벗어남 = 빛에 '갇힘' = 정답 ②
→ 나방은 빛에 이끌리는 게 아니라 빛에 '갇혀' 벗어나지 못함 = ② trapped
회색(도입)과 Mach band·halo 등 개별 가설은 '갇힘'을 설명하는 예시일 뿐, 결론에 부차적.

34빈칸추론 3점평가원 2024학년도 수능 34번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
Everyone who drives, walks, or swipes a transit card in a city views herself as a transportation expert from the moment she walks out the front door. And how she views the street    . That’s why we find so many well-intentioned and civic-minded citizens arguing past one another. At neighborhood meetings in school auditoriums, and in back rooms at libraries and churches, local residents across the nation gather for often-contentious discussions about transportation proposals that would change a city’s streets. And like all politics, all transportation is local and intensely personal. A transit project that could speed travel for tens of thousands of people can be stopped by objections to the loss of a few parking spaces or by the simple fear that the project won’t work. It’s not a challenge of the data or the traffic engineering or the planning. Public debates about streets are typically rooted in emotional assumptions about how a change will affect a person’s commute, ability to park, belief about what is safe and what isn’t, or the bottom line of a local business.
빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

📢 신호 리마인더

It’s not a challenge of the data or the traffic engineering or the planning. ③Public debates about streets are typically 인과rooted in emotional assumptions about how a change will affect a person’s 근거commute, ability to park, belief about what is safe and what isn’t, or the bottom line of a local business.
🟡 노란색 문장만으로 정답이 나오는 과정 (노랑①②③ = 위 지문에 같은 번호로 칠한 노랑 문장)
  1. 노랑①“Everyone who drives, walks, or swipes a transit card in a city views herself as a …”운전·보행·교통카드를 쓰는 모든 사람이 문을 나서는 순간 자신을 교통 전문가로 여긴다 — — 관점이 '자기 이동 방식'에서 나옴
  2. 노랑②“And how she views the street ______.”그리고 거리를 보는 그녀의 관점은 ______ — — 앞 논리로 빈칸 = 그녀가 이동하는 방식과 밀접
  3. 노랑③“Public debates about streets are typically rooted in emotional assumptions about how a change …”거리 논쟁은 변화가 통근·주차에 미칠 영향에 대한 감정적 가정에 뿌리를 둔다 — — 빈칸 = 이동 방식과 긴밀히 연동 = 정답 ④
→ 거리에 대한 관점은 그녀가 이동하는 방식과 긴밀히 맞물림 = ④
회색(회의 장소·주차 반대·데이터 부연)은 빼도 '관점 = 개인 이동 방식' 논리 유지.
패러프레이즈 views herself as a transportation expert (drives, walks, swipes) · how a change will affect her commute, ability to park → tracks pretty closely with how she gets around ✓ / 복사 함정 streets
①relies heavily on how others see her city’s streets자기 도시의 거리를 다른 사람들이 어떻게 보는지에 크게 의존한다✘ 정반대
②updates itself with each new public transit policy새로운 대중교통 정책이 나올 때마다 스스로 갱신된다✘ 없음
③arises independently of the streets she travels on그녀가 다니는 거리와 무관하게 형성된다✘ 정반대
④tracks pretty closely with how she gets around그녀가 이동하는 방식과 상당히 밀접하게 일치한다✔ 근거
⑤ties firmly in with how her city operates그녀의 도시가 작동하는 방식과 확고히 연결된다✘ 범위초과

Kinship ties continue to be important today. In modern societies such as the United States people frequently have family get-togethers, they telephone their relatives regularly, and they provide their kin with a wide variety of services. ①Eugene Litwak has referred to this pattern of behaviour as the ‘modified extended family’. ②It is an extended family structure because multigenerational ties are maintained, but it is modified because it does not usually rest on co-residence between the generations and most extended families do not act as corporate groups. ③Although modified extended family members often live close by, the modified extended family does not require geographical proximity and ties are maintained even when kin are separated by considerable distances. ④The oldest member of the family makes the decisions on important issues, no matter how far away family members live from each other. ⑤In contrast to the traditional extended family where kin always live in close proximity, the members of modified extended families may freely move away from kin to seek opportunities for occupational advancement.
다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?
① ② ③ ④ ⑤ 중 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장의 번호를 고르시오.

Since their introduction, information systems have substantially changed the way business is conducted. ①This is particularly true for business in the shape and form of cooperation between firms that involves an integration of value chains across multiple units. ②The resulting networks do not only cover the business units of a single firm but typically also include multiple units from different firms. ③As a consequence, firms do not only need to consider their internal organization in order to ensure sustainable business performance; they also need to take into account the entire ecosystem of units surrounding them. ④Many major companies are fundamentally changing their business models by focusing on profitable units and cutting off less profitable ones.✕ 흐름과 무관 ⑤In order to allow these different units to cooperate successfully, the existence of a common platform is crucial.
🟡 노란색 문장만으로 정답이 나오는 과정 (노랑①②③ = 위 지문에 같은 번호로 칠한 노랑 문장)
  1. 노랑①“Since their introduction, information systems have substantially changed the way business is …”정보 시스템이 기업 운영 방식을 크게 바꿈 — — 소재: 정보 시스템과 기업 (협력)
  2. 노랑②“This is particularly true for business in the shape and form of cooperation between firms that …”특히 여러 단위에 걸친 기업 간 협력에서 그러함 — — 기업 간 네트워크·생태계로 확장
  3. 노랑③“In order to allow these different units to cooperate successfully, the existence of a common …”이 단위들이 협력하려면 공동 플랫폼이 필수 — — '정보시스템→기업협력→생태계→공동플랫폼' 흐름 → ④만 무관 = 정답 ④
→ ④는 '수익 단위에 집중하고 비수익 단위를 잘라낸다'는 수익성·구조조정 이야기 = 협력·플랫폼 흐름과 무관 = ④
①②③⑤는 '정보시스템→기업 간 협력→생태계 고려→공동 플랫폼'으로 이어지지만 ④만 소재(수익성)가 벗어남.
패러프레이즈 정보 시스템 기반 기업 간 협력·네트워크·공동 플랫폼 → ④ 수익성 집중·비수익 단위 제거(구조조정) ✓

②The resulting networks do not only cov…흐름 유지
③As a consequence, firms do not only ne…흐름 유지
④Many major companies are fundamentally…✔ 주제 이탈 → 정답

🟡 무조건 읽는 문장 — 슬래시(/)로 끊어 읽기 · 영↔한 대응
1
Since their introduction, / information systems have / substantially changed the way business is conducted.
그것들이 도입된 이래, / 정보 시스템은 / 기업이 운영되는 방식을 상당히 바꾸어 왔다. ← 주제문: 정보 시스템이 기업을 바꿈
2
This is particularly true for business / in the shape and form of cooperation between firms / that involves an integration of value chains across multiple units.
이것은 특히 기업에 대해 사실이다 / 기업 간 협력의 형태를 띠는 / 여러 단위에 걸친 가치 사슬의 통합을 수반하는. ← 근거: 기업 간 협력
3
In order to allow these different units to cooperate successfully, / the existence of a common platform is crucial.
이 서로 다른 단위들이 성공적으로 협력하도록 하려면, / 공동 플랫폼의 존재가 필수적이다. ← 근거: 공동 플랫폼 필수
④정답 수익 단위 집중·비수익 단위 제거 = 협력·플랫폼 흐름과 무관 · ①기업 간 협력 ②다기업 네트워크 ③생태계 고려 ⑤공동 플랫폼 필수
🔁재진술 지도 재진술 연결 문제 · 정답 패러프레이징
핵심(A)정보 시스템은 기업 간 협력·네트워크를 확장시켜 공동 플랫폼을 필수로 만든다
같은 소재 A가 A→A′→A″→A‴로 표현만 바뀌며 되풀이 → 마지막이 정답 선지
Acooperation between firms that involves an integration of value chains가치 사슬 통합을 수반하는 기업 간 협력
A′↓귀결the existence of a common platform is crucial공동 플랫폼의 존재가 필수적
정답'focusing on profitable units and cutting off less profitable ones' 수익성·구조조정 문장은 협력·플랫폼 흐름과 무관 = ④

35무관한 문장 평가원 2023학년도 6월 35번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
The animal in a conflict between attacking a rival and fleeing may initially not have sufficient information to enable it to make a decision straight away. ①If the rival is likely to win the fight, then the optimal decision would be to give up immediately and not risk getting injured. ②But if the rival is weak and easily defeatable, then there could be considerable benefit in going ahead and obtaining the territory, females, food or whatever is at stake. ③Animals under normal circumstances maintain a very constant body weight and they eat and drink enough for their needs at regular intervals. ④By taking a little extra time to collect information about the opponent, the animal is more likely to reach a decision that maximizes its chances of winning than if it takes a decision without such information. ⑤Many signals are now seen as having this information gathering or ‘assessment’ function, directly contributing to the mechanism of the decision-making process by supplying vital information about the likely outcomes of the various options.
다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?
① ② ③ ④ ⑤ 중 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장의 번호를 고르시오.
📢 신호 리마인더
핵심 sufficient information부연 give up immediately부연 considerable benefit핵심 collect information핵심 assessment예시·부연 ✕ 넘김
✅ 셀프 체크
  • 근거 신호 문장을 찾아 칠했나?
  • 예시·양보절은 회색으로 넘겼나?
  • 지문 단어 그대로 쓴 선지부터 지웠나?

🟡 무조건 읽는 문장 — 슬래시(/)로 끊어 읽기 · 영↔한 대응
1
The animal in a conflict between attacking a rival and fleeing / may initially not have sufficient information / to enable it to make a decision straight away.
경쟁자를 공격할지 달아날지 갈등하는 동물은 / 처음엔 충분한 정보가 없을 수 있다 / 즉시 결정을 내리게 해 준다. ← 주제문: 즉시 결정할 정보가 부족
2
By taking a little extra time to collect information about the opponent, / the animal is more likely to reach a decision / that maximizes its chances of winning / than if it takes a decision without such information.
상대에 대한 정보를 모으는 데 약간의 시간을 더 들임으로써, / 그 동물은 결정에 도달할 가능성이 더 높다 / 승리 가능성을 극대화하는 / 그런 정보 없이 결정할 때보다. ← 근거: 정보 수집이 더 나은 결정으로
3
Many signals are now seen as having this information gathering or ‘assessment’ function, / directly contributing to the mechanism of the decision-making process / by supplying vital information about the likely outcomes of the various options.
많은 신호는 이제 이 정보 수집 혹은 '평가' 기능을 갖는 것으로 여겨진다, / 의사결정 과정의 기제에 직접 기여하면서, / 다양한 선택의 가능한 결과에 관한 핵심 정보를 제공함으로써. ← 근거: 신호=정보 수집·평가 기능 → 의사결정에 기여
③정답 동물은 일정 체중 유지·규칙적 섭취 = 의사결정 흐름과 무관 · ①강한 상대엔 포기 ②약한 상대엔 이득 ④정보가 결정 개선 ⑤신호=정보수집 기능
🔁재진술 지도 재진술 연결 문제 · 정답 패러프레이징

같은 소재 A가 A→A′→A″→A‴로 표현만 바뀌며 되풀이 → 마지막이 정답 선지

Plants have a remarkable ability to recover from disaster. ①This is largely because they have preferential access to the tissues that rebuild their organs. ②Throughout their life cycle, plants retain meristems, which are regions of undifferentiated tissue that can differentiate into new shoots and other organs. ③This phenomenon occurs at very different scales, ranging from the healing of a small scar to the regrowth of an entire plant. ④Animals, by contrast, invest heavily in learned behaviors that help them avoid predators and find food. ⑤After being disturbed, a plant community can adjust its composition through regeneration, mainly resprouting and reseeding.
다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?
① ② ③ ④ ⑤ 중 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장의 번호를 고르시오.
📢 신호 리마인더
첫문장정의 meristems끝문장예시·부연 ✕ 넘김

🟡 무조건 읽는 문장 — 슬래시(/)로 끊어 읽기 · 영↔한 대응
1
Plants have / a remarkable ability / to recover from disaster.
식물은 가지고 있다 / 놀라운 능력을 / 재난에서 회복하는. ← 주제문: 식물의 회복 능력
2
Throughout their life cycle, / plants retain meristems, / which are regions of undifferentiated tissue / that can differentiate into new shoots and other organs.
그들의 생애 주기 내내, / 식물은 분열조직을 유지하는데, / 그것은 미분화 조직의 영역이다 / 새로운 싹과 다른 기관으로 분화할 수 있는. ← 근거: 분열조직이 회복의 기반
3
After being disturbed, / a plant community can adjust its composition / through regeneration, / mainly resprouting and reseeding.
교란된 후에, / 식물 군집은 그 구성을 조정할 수 있다 / 재생을 통해, / 주로 재발아와 재파종으로. ← 근거: 재생을 통한 구성 조정
④정답 동물의 학습 행동(=소재 이탈) · ①②③⑤ 모두 식물 재생 흐름 유지
🔁재진술 지도 재진술 연결 문제 · 정답 패러프레이징
핵심(A)식물은 분열조직으로 재해에서 재생하는 능력을 지닌다
같은 소재 A가 A→A′→A″→A‴로 표현만 바뀌며 되풀이 → 마지막이 정답 선지
APlants have a remarkable ability to recover from disaster식물은 재해에서 회복하는 놀라운 능력이 있다
A′↓반복plants retain meristems, which are regions of undifferentiated tissue that can differentiate into new shoots분열조직으로 새 기관을 재생한다
A′′↓반복a plant community can adjust its composition through regeneration군집도 재생으로 구성을 조정한다
정답무관 문장은 식물 재생 흐름을 벗어나 'Animals'의 학습 행동을 다룸

Actors, singers, politicians and countless others recognise the power of the human voice as a means of communication beyond the simple decoding of the words that are used. Learning to control your voice and use it for different purposes is, therefore, one of the most important skills to develop as an early career teacher. ①The more confidently you give instructions, the higher the chance of a positive class response. ②There are times when being able to project your voice loudly will be very useful when working in school, and knowing that you can cut through a noisy classroom, dinner hall or playground is a great skill to have. ③In order to address serious noise issues in school, students, parents and teachers should search for a solution together. ④However, I would always advise that you use your loudest voice incredibly sparingly and avoid shouting as much as possible. ⑤A quiet, authoritative and measured tone has so much more impact than slightly panicked shouting.
다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?
① ② ③ ④ ⑤ 중 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장의 번호를 고르시오.
📢 신호 리마인더
도입 human voice주제 control your voice부연 confidently핵심 project your voice핵심 loudest voice결론 measured tone예시·부연 ✕ 넘김

  • 지문 단어 그대로 쓴 선지부터 지웠나?

  2. 노랑②“There are times when being able to project your voice loudly will be very useful when working …”때로 목소리를 크게 내는 것이 유용 — — 목소리 사용법의 한 측면
  3. 노랑③“However, I would always advise that you use your loudest voice incredibly sparingly and avoid …”그러나 가장 큰 목소리는 아껴 쓰라(조용한 톤이 더 효과적) — — 시종 '목소리 조절·사용' → ③만 무관 = 정답 ③

🟡 무조건 읽는 문장 — 슬래시(/)로 끊어 읽기 · 영↔한 대응
1
Learning to control your voice / and use it for different purposes is, therefore, / one of the most important skills to develop as an early career teacher.
자신의 목소리를 조절하는 법을 배우는 것은 / 그리고 그것을 다양한 목적에 사용하는 것은, 따라서, / 초임 교사로서 길러야 할 가장 중요한 기술 중 하나이다. ← 주제문: 목소리 조절이 교사의 핵심 기술
2
There are times when being able to project your voice loudly / will be very useful when working in school, / and knowing that you can cut through a noisy classroom, dinner hall or playground is a great skill to have.
목소리를 크게 낼 수 있는 것이 유용한 때가 있다 / 학교에서 일할 때 매우 유용할 것이며, / 시끄러운 교실, 식당, 운동장을 뚫고 낼 수 있음을 아는 것은 대단한 기술이다. ← 근거: 큰 목소리가 유용
3
However, I would always advise / that you use your loudest voice incredibly sparingly / and avoid shouting as much as possible.
그러나 나는 항상 조언하겠다 / 가장 큰 목소리는 극도로 아껴 쓰고 / 가능한 한 소리 지르는 것을 피하라고. ← 근거: 큰 목소리는 아껴 쓰라
③정답 학교 소음 문제를 함께 해결하자 = 목소리 조절 흐름과 무관 · ①자신감 있는 지시 ②큰 목소리 유용 ④큰 목소리 아껴쓰기 ⑤조용한 톤이 효과적
🔁재진술 지도 재진술 연결 문제 · 정답 패러프레이징
핵심(A)교사는 목적에 맞게 목소리를 조절해 사용해야 한다
같은 소재 A가 A→A′→A″→A‴로 표현만 바뀌며 되풀이 → 마지막이 정답 선지
ALearning to control your voice ... one of the most important skills목소리 조절이 교사의 핵심 기술
A′↓세부use your loudest voice incredibly sparingly가장 큰 목소리는 아껴 쓰라
정답'address serious noise issues ... search for a solution together' 소음 대책 문장은 목소리 조절 흐름과 무관 = ③

35무관한 문장 평가원 2024학년도 6월 35번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
Interestingly, experts do not suffer as much as beginners when performing complex tasks or combining multiple tasks. Because experts have extensive practice within a limited domain, the key component skills in their domain tend to be highly practiced and more automated. ①Each of these highly practiced skills then demands relatively few cognitive resources, effectively lowering the total cognitive load that experts experience. ②Thus, experts can perform complex tasks and combine multiple tasks relatively easily. ③Furthermore, beginners are excellent at processing the tasks when the tasks are divided and isolated. ④This is not because they necessarily have more cognitive resources than beginners; rather, because of the high level of fluency they have achieved in performing key skills, they can do more with what they have. ⑤Beginners, on the other hand, have not achieved the same degree of fluency and automaticity in each of the component skills, and thus they struggle to combine skills that experts combine with relative ease and efficiency.
다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?
① ② ③ ④ ⑤ 중 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장의 번호를 고르시오.
📢 신호 리마인더

Because of this, employees who telecommute are often perceived as less committed than those in the office. ③New digital devices emerge every year, and firms compete fiercely to design products best suited for global consumer markets. ④With regard to such misperceptions, organizations must train managers to evaluate workers by results rather than by hours seen at a desk. ⑤Only when these barriers are removed will flexible workplace programs gain full acceptance.

Speaking fast is a high-risk proposition. It’s nearly impossible to maintain the ideal conditions to be persuasive, well-spoken, and effective when the mouth is traveling well over the speed limit. ①Although we’d like to think that our minds are sharp enough to always make good decisions with the greatest efficiency, they just aren’t. ②In reality, the brain arrives at an intersection of four or five possible things to say and sits idling for a couple of seconds, considering the options. ③Making a good decision helps you speak faster because it provides you with more time to come up with your responses. ④When the brain stops sending navigational instructions back to the mouth and the mouth is moving too fast to pause, that’s when you get a verbal fender bender, otherwise known as filler. ⑤Um, ah, you know, and like are what your mouth does when it has nowhere to go.
다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?
① ② ③ ④ ⑤ 중 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장의 번호를 고르시오.

1
Speaking fast / is a high-risk proposition.
빠르게 말하는 것은 / 위험이 큰 일이다. ← 주제문: 빠른 말하기는 위험
2
In reality, the brain arrives at an intersection / of four or five possible things to say / and sits idling for a couple of seconds, considering the options.
실제로 뇌는 교차로에 도달해 / 말할 수 있는 네다섯 가지 선택지 앞에서 / 선택지를 따져 보며 몇 초간 멈춰 공회전한다. ← 근거: 뇌가 판단하느라 멈춤
3

The expansion of sports tourism in the twentieth century has been influenced by further developments in transportation. Just as the railways revolutionized travel in the nineteenth century, so the automobile produced even more dramatic changes in the twentieth. ①The significance of the car in the development of sport and tourism generally has attracted considerable coverage and it has had no less an impact on sports tourism specifically. ②Although originally invented towards the end of the nineteenth century, it started to become a mass form of transport in the 1920s in the USA and rather later in Britain. ③Apart from its convenience and flexibility, the car has the additional advantages of affording access to many areas not served by public transport, as well as allowing the easy transport of luggage and equipment. ④The expansion of reasonably priced, good quality accommodation associated with tourism growth has also facilitated the growth of locally based restaurants. ⑤As a result, it was invaluable for the development of many forms of sports tourism but especially those which require the transportation of people and equipment to relatively remote locations.

형광펜 3색🟡 정답 핵심무조건 읽기🟩 주제·배경화제만 파악 · 근거 아님⬜ 예시·부연넘겨도 됨반복어 = 신호어 없이 자리·반복어·정의로 잡는 노랑관계어 = 인과·등호·대조·비교 논리 신호 (PART 0 구문 사전)긍정＋ 부정− = ±어휘 (PART 0 ± 사전)
All workers need access to mentors that can provide them with valuable information about their job, their workplace, and the resources that are available within their organization. Mentors also provide much needed psychosocial support. ①Having a diverse network of mentors is important for dominant and minority group members alike. ②Minority group members need diverse mentors so that they can gain insight into what it means to be employed by a particular organization or in a particular field or profession. ③Majority workers benefit by having a network of diverse mentors because it increases their understanding and sensitivity to the unique realities of diverse workers and their own identity, and perhaps even their own forms of privilege. ④Mentoring has been typically required and praised as an essential component in the personal development of employers.✕ 흐름과 무관 ⑤The ultimate goal of these mentoring opportunities is to have individuals be more informed, identified, and engaged in their work and in their organization.
🟡 노란색 문장만으로 정답이 나오는 과정 (노랑①②③ = 위 지문에 같은 번호로 칠한 노랑 문장)
  1. 노랑①“Having a diverse network of mentors is important for dominant and minority group members alike.”다양한 멘토 네트워크는 다수·소수 구성원 모두에게 중요하다 — — 글 전체 소재 = '다양한 멘토의 유익'
  2. 노랑②“Minority group members need diverse mentors so that they can gain insight into what it means …”소수 집단은 다양한 멘토로 통찰을 얻는다 — — 소수 측 유익
  3. 노랑③“Majority workers benefit by having a network of diverse mentors because it increases their …”다수 노동자도 이해·민감성이 높아져 이득을 본다 — — '모두에 중요→소수·다수 유익' 흐름 → ④(고용주)만 무관 = 정답 ④
→ ④는 '멘토링이 고용주의 개인 발전에 필수 요소로 요구·칭송돼 왔다'는 고용주 이야기 = 노동자를 위한 다양한 멘토의 유익 흐름과 무관 = ④
①②③⑤는 다양한 멘토 네트워크가 소수·다수 노동자 모두에게 주는 유익으로 이어지지만 ④만 고용주로 대상이 바뀌어 벗어난다.

🟡 무조건 읽는 문장 — 슬래시(/)로 끊어 읽기 · 영↔한 대응
1
Having a diverse network of mentors is important / for dominant and minority group members alike.
다양한 멘토 네트워크를 갖는 것은 중요하다 / 지배 집단과 소수 집단 구성원 모두에게 똑같이. ← 주제문: 다양한 멘토는 모두에게 중요
2
Minority group members need diverse mentors / so that they can gain insight / into what it means to be employed by a particular organization or in a particular field or profession.
소수 집단 구성원은 다양한 멘토가 필요하다 / 그래서 통찰을 얻을 수 있도록 / 특정 조직이나 특정 분야·직종에 고용된다는 것이 무엇인지에 대한. ← 근거: 소수 집단은 다양한 멘토로 통찰 획득
3
Majority workers benefit by having a network of diverse mentors / because it increases their understanding and sensitivity / to the unique realities of diverse workers and their own identity, / and perhaps even their own forms of privilege.
다수 집단 노동자도 다양한 멘토 네트워크로 이득을 본다 / 그것이 이해와 민감성을 높이기 때문에 / 다양한 노동자의 고유한 현실과 자신의 정체성에 대한, / 그리고 어쩌면 자신의 특권 형태에 대한 것까지. ← 근거: 다수 집단도 다양한 멘토로 이해·민감성 향상
④정답 멘토링은 고용주 개인발전의 필수 = 노동자·다양한 멘토 흐름과 무관 · ①모두에 중요 ②소수 통찰 ③다수 이득 ⑤궁극 목표

🖍 신호 사전을 떠올리며 무조건 읽을 문장에 형광펜을 직접 치고, 예시는 넘기며 답을 골라보세요.
The bigger someone is, the more damage they can do to themselves through even a relatively innocuous accident. Despite toddlers falling over and bumping themselves regularly, the injuries they sustain are rarely serious. ①Their relatively thick bones in comparison to their mass mean they rarely build up enough energy, even at top speed, to do themselves much damage. ②Because of their increased mass (compounded by the fact that they are falling from a greater height and that their reactions may be slower), adults falling over will impact the ground with a much larger force. ③The nonlinear relationship between mass and bone strength means that although their bones are thicker than a toddler’s in absolute terms, they may not be relatively thick enough to compensate for the larger impact caused by their increased mass. ④The body mass index (BMI) can serve as a convenient way for non-experts to examine their health conditions in daily lives. ⑤For the same reasons, taller people have been found to suffer more fall-related injuries ― like hip breaks ― than shorter people.
다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?
① ② ③ ④ ⑤ 중 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장의 번호를 고르시오.
📢 신호 리마인더
주제 the more damage대조 toddlers근거 thick bones핵심 larger force부연 nonlinear relationship결론 taller people예시·부연 ✕ 넘김
✅ 셀프 체크
  • 근거 신호 문장을 찾아 칠했나?
  • 예시·양보절은 회색으로 넘겼나?
  • 지문 단어 그대로 쓴 선지부터 지웠나?

35무관한 문장STEP 3 · 해석 (직독직해)🟡문장·선지만
🟡 무조건 읽는 문장 — 슬래시(/)로 끊어 읽기 · 영↔한 대응
1
The bigger someone is, / the more damage they can do to / themselves through even a relatively innocuous accident.
누군가가 몸집이 클수록, / 그들이 자신에게 입힐 수 있는 손상은 더 크다 / 비교적 무해한 사고를 통해서도. ← 주제문: 몸집이 클수록 손상 큼
2
Because of their increased mass / (compounded by the fact that they are falling from a greater height and that their reactions may be slower), / adults falling over will impact the ground with a much larger force.
그들의 늘어난 질량 때문에 / (더 높은 곳에서 떨어지고 반응이 더 느릴 수 있다는 사실이 겹쳐), / 넘어지는 어른은 훨씬 더 큰 힘으로 땅에 부딪친다. ← 근거: 질량↑ → 충격력↑
3
For the same reasons, / taller people have been found to suffer more fall-related injuries / ― like hip breaks ― than shorter people.
같은 이유로, / 키가 큰 사람이 낙상 관련 부상을 더 많이 겪는 것으로 밝혀졌다 / ― 고관절 골절 같은 ― 키 작은 사람보다. ← 결론: 키 큰 사람이 부상 더 겪음
④정답 BMI가 건강 점검에 편리한 도구 = 몸집·낙상 손상 흐름과 무관 · ①아기 뼈 두꺼워 손상↓ ②어른 큰 힘 충돌 ③비선형 관계 ⑤키 큰 사람 부상↑
🔁재진술 지도 재진술 연결 문제 · 정답 패러프레이징
핵심(A)몸집이 클수록 낙상 시 더 큰 힘을 받아 부상 위험이 커진다
같은 소재 A가 A→A′→A″→A‴로 표현만 바뀌며 되풀이 → 마지막이 정답 선지

1-PASS

순서를 '한 번에' 푸는 법

형광펜 독해 · 유형 특강
왜 자꾸 여러 번 읽게 될까? — 조각의 '내용'을 이해하려 읽기 때문. 순서·삽입은 이해 문제가 아니라 '어디에 붙나'를 잇는 문제다. 읽는 목적을 “무슨 말이지?” → “어디에 붙지?” 로 바꾸면 한 번의 전진 읽기로 끝난다.
순서 — 한 번에 푸는 3단계
STEP 1끝에서 갈고리 하나주어진 글의 끝에서 “다음엔 반드시 ___가 와야 한다”를 딱 하나만 건다.
STEP 2첫머리만 본다(A)(B)(C)의 첫 1~2문장만. 몸통은 건너뛰고 갈고리를 채우는 조각을 고른다.
STEP 3끝→첫머리 반복고른 조각의 끝에서 새 갈고리 → 남은 첫머리에 맞춘다. 되돌아가지 않는다.
시범 — 몸통은 넘기고 '이음매'만 따라간다
각 조각의 첫머리(이음매)만 진하게, 몸통은 흐리게 표시했다. 순서는 첫머리 단서만으로 정해진다. (2024학년도 수능 37번)
단서 색: 지시어시간·순서연결어
주어진 글
Norms emerge in groups … Thus, the start of a norm occurs when one person acts …
갈고리한 사람이 '그 행동'을 시작 → 다음엔 그 행동을 이어받는 조각이 와야 함
(C)
Others may then conform to this behavior then … The person who performed the initial action may think …
이음매this behavior·then = 주어진 글의 그 행동을 받음 → 주어진 글 바로 뒤
(A)
Thus, she may prescribe the behavior to them … Alternately, she may communicate … In addition, she may threaten to sanction them …
이음매them = (C)의 'others' → (C) 뒤
(B)
But some others will not need to have the behavior prescribed … They will observe the regularity of behavior … either rational or moral reasons.
이음매But = (A)의 '규정하면 따른다'를 뒤집어 마무리 → (A) 뒤
읽은 것은 이음매 4곳뿐 (몸통 7문장은 안 읽음).  주어진 글 → (C) → (A) → (B)  ∴ 정답 (C)-(A)-(B)
재독을 없애는 습관 3
  1. 묻는 것 먼저 — 주어진 글·넣을 문장부터. 갈고리를 쥐고 본문에 들어가면 되돌아갈 일이 없다.
  2. 몸통 말고 이음매 — 조각의 끝과 다음 첫머리만. 가운데 문장은 순서 판단에 필요 없다.
  3. 눈으로 외우지 말고 손으로 표시 — 지시어→선행어를 화살표로 그으며 간다.

36

36-37번대 · 실제 기출 28문항
유형 공식지시어·연결어·시간으로 조각을 잇는다 (노랑 형광펜 아님)
이렇게 접근한다각 조각의 첫머리 지시어·연결어가 어느 조각 뒤에 오는지로 사슬을 잇는다. 학생들이 가장 어려워하는 유형 — 지시어만 잡으면 풀린다.
🔎 지시어 잡는 법 — 이 유형의 열쇠
  • this/that/these + 명사 → 바로 앞에 그 명사·개념이 있어야 함
  • it/they/them → 수(단·복수) 맞는 가장 가까운 앞 명사
  • such · the same · another → '먼저 나온 것'이 전제
  • 핵심: 지시어는 늘 '앞'을 가리킨다. 선행어가 앞에 없으면 그 자리엔 못 온다.
🚫 오답 찍기 방지 체크
  • 지시어 없는 조각 = 대개 첫 번째(주어진 글 바로 뒤)
  • 각 조각 첫 단어부터 확인 — 성급히 첫 조각 확정 금지
  • 연결어 방향(But 역접·also 첨가·so 인과) 어긋나면 오답
✏️ 지시어 미니 드릴 — 밑줄이 가리키는 것은?
Robots now handle many factory jobs. These changes worry some workers. → robots handling factory jobs
She solved the puzzle in seconds. Such speed amazed everyone. → solving the puzzle in seconds
The city built three new parks. They soon became popular. → the three new parks

지시어 this·that연결어 However·So연대·순서

37글의 순서 3점평가원 2024학년도 수능 37번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 노랑 형광펜이 아니라 각 조각의 지시어·연결어·시간 표현을 표시해 이어보세요.
Norms emerge in groups as a result of people conforming to the behavior of others. Thus, the start of a norm occurs when one person acts in a particular manner in a particular situation because she thinks she ought to. (C) Others may then conform to this behavior for a number of reasons. The person who performed the initial action may think that others ought to behave as she behaves in situations of this sort. (A) Thus, she may prescribe the behavior to them by uttering the norm statement in a prescriptive manner. Alternately, she may communicate that conformity is desired in other ways, such as by gesturing. In addition, she may threaten to sanction them for not behaving as she wishes. This will cause some to conform to her wishes and act as she acts. (B) But some others will not need to have the behavior prescribed to them. They will observe the regularity of behavior and decide on their own that they ought to conform. They may do so for either rational or moral reasons.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
④ (B)⑤ (A)

Norms emerge in groups as a result of people conforming to the behavior of others. Thus, the start of a norm occurs when one person acts in a particular manner in a particular situation because she thinks she ought to. (C) Others may then conform to this behavior for a number of reasons. The person who performed the initial action may think that others ought to behave as she behaves in situations of this sort. 🔗 연결고리로 순서를 잇는 과정 (노랑 형광펜이 아니라 지시어·연결어·시간으로 조각을 연결)
this behavior지시어(C) 첫머리 'Others may then conform to this behavior' — 앞에 '한 사람이 행동을 시작함'이 있어야 하므로 주어진 글 바로 뒤

  1. 1주어진 글: 한 사람이 상황에서 스스로 옳다고 여겨 특정 행동을 시작(규범의 발단)

37글의 순서 평가원 2022학년도 6월 37번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 노랑 형광펜이 아니라 각 조각의 지시어·연결어·시간 표현을 표시해 이어보세요.
A firm is deciding whether to invest in shipbuilding. If it can produce at sufficiently large scale, it knows the venture will be profitable. There is a “good” outcome, in which both types of investments are made, and both the shipyard and the steelmakers end up profitable and happy. Equilibrium is reached. Then there is a “bad” outcome, in which neither type of investment is made. This second outcome also is an equilibrium because the decisions not to invest reinforce each other. Assume that shipyards are the only potential customers of steel. Steel producers figure they’ll make money if there’s a shipyard to buy their steel, but not otherwise. Now we have two possible outcomes ― what economists call “multiple equilibria.” But one key input is low-cost steel, and it must be produced nearby. The company’s decision boils down to this: if there is a steel factory close by, invest in shipbuilding; otherwise, don’t invest. Now consider the thinking of potential steel investors in the region.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

지시어연결어시간·순서 만 표시 — 노랑 형광펜은 쓰지 않아요
A firm is deciding whether to invest in shipbuilding. If it can produce at sufficiently large scale, it knows the venture will be profitable. There is a “good” outcome, in which both types of investments are made, and both the shipyard and the steelmakers end up profitable and happy. Equilibrium is reached. Then there is a “bad” outcome, in which neither type of investment is made. This second outcome also is an equilibrium because the decisions not to invest reinforce each other. Assume that shipyards are the only potential customers of steel. Steel producers figure they’ll make money if there’s a shipyard to buy their steel, but not otherwise. Now we have two possible outcomes ― what economists call “multiple equilibria.” But one key input is low-cost steel, and it must be produced nearby. The company’s decision boils down to this: if there is a steel factory close by, invest in shipbuilding; otherwise, don’t invest. Now consider the thinking of potential steel investors in the region.

But one key input is low-cost steel연결어(C)의 'But'이 주어진 글의 '대규모면 수익'을 보완하며 철강 조건을 도입 — 주어진 글 바로 뒤
Now consider the thinking of potential steel investors in the region대응·반복(C) 끝의 '철강 투자자의 생각'이 (B)의 '철강 생산자 가정'으로 이어짐 — (C) 뒤 (B)
Now we have two possible outcomes ― what economists call대응·반복(B)가 먼저 '두 가지 결과(multiple equilibria)'를 제시해야 (A)가 그 결과를 열거할 수 있음 — (B) 뒤 (A)

  1. 1주어진 글: 한 회사가 대규모면 수익이라며 조선업 투자를 고민

  3. 3(B): '철강 생산자는 조선소가 있어야 돈을 번다'며 '두 가지 결과(다중 균형)'를 제시
  4. 4(A): 'This second outcome'처럼 (B)의 두 결과를 '좋은·나쁜 결과'로 열거 → (C)-(B)-(A)
→ 정답: (C)-(B)-(A)

주어진 글
첫머리 단서 없음
A firm is deciding whether to invest in shipbuilding. If it can produce at sufficiently large scale, it knows the venture will be profitable.
한 회사가 조선업 투자 여부를 결정 중이다. 충분히 큰 규모로 생산할 수 있으면 수익이 남다는 것을 안다.

But one key input is low-cost steel, and it must be produced nearby. The company’s decision boils down to this: if there is a steel factory close by, invest in shipbuilding; otherwise, don’t invest. Now consider the thinking of potential steel investors in the region.
하지만 한 가지 핵심 투입물은 저가 철강이며, 그것은 근처에서 생산되어야 한다. 이제 그 지역 잠재적 철강 투자자의 생각을 고려하라.

Assume that shipyards are the only potential customers of steel. Steel producers figure they’ll make money if there’s a shipyard to buy their steel, but not otherwise. Now we have two possible outcomes ― what economists call “multiple equilibria.”
조선소가 철강의 유일한 잠재 고객이라고 가정하라. 이제 우리는 두 가지 가능한 결과, 경제학자가 '다중 균형'이라 부르는 것을 갖게 된다.

Then there is a “bad” outcome, in which neither type of investment is made. This second outcome also is an equilibrium because the decisions not to invest reinforce each other.

If learning were simply a matter of accumulating lists of facts, then it shouldn’t make any difference if we are presented with information that is just a little bit beyond what we already know or totally new information. If we are trying to understand something totally new, however, we need to make larger adjustments to the units of the patterns we already have, which requires changing the strengths of large numbers of connections in our brain, and this is a difficult, tiring process. The adjustments are clearly smallest when the new information is only slightly new ― when it is compatible with what we already know, so that the old patterns need only a little bit of adjustment to accommodate the new knowledge. Each fact would simply be stored separately. According to connectionist theory, however, our knowledge is organized into patterns of activity, and each time we learn something new we have to modify the old patterns so as to keep the old material while adding the new information.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
④ (B)⑤ (A)

The intuitive ability to classify and generalize is undoubtedly a useful feature of life and research, but it carries a high cost, such as in our tendency to stereotype generalizations about people and situations. (A) Intuitively and quickly, we mentally sort things into groups based on what we perceive the differences between them to be, and that is the basis for stereotyping. Only afterwards do we examine (or not examine) more evidence of how things are differentiated, and the degree and significance of the variations. (B) Our brain performs these tasks efficiently and automatically, usually without our awareness. The real danger of stereotypes is not their inaccuracy, but their lack of flexibility and their tendency to be preserved, even when we have enough time to stop and consider. (C) For most people, the word stereotype arouses negative connotations: it implies a negative bias. But, in fact, stereotypes do not differ in principle from all other generalizations; generalizations about groups of people are not necessarily always negative.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

37글의 순서 평가원 2027학년도 6월 37번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 노랑 형광펜이 아니라 각 조각의 지시어·연결어·시간 표현을 표시해 이어보세요.
Although there may be elements that trigger instinctive response, spectacle works primarily within a cultural frame and is subject to prevailing modes of perception that observers bring to bear. In saying that, we stress that creation of spectacle is neither a universal nor even an inevitable expression of culture, but is a strategy commonly used by people from many different cultures to address specific needs. The task of creating spectacle has been likened to creating new works of literature, where writers normally feel bound by the rules and traditions of their genre yet need to show sufficient originality to impress their audiences. By extension, spectacle is produced by working with the grain of a particular culture, blending the innovative with the established. Thus anyone deploying spectacle may draw on a repertoire of techniques and conventions developed from previous festivals or related activities, but imitation is not enough. Spectacle must also be spectacular. A spectacle has to amaze spectators, outdoing previous efforts if it is to become part of the collective memory of those who witnessed and participated in it.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
④ (B)⑤ (A)

37글의 순서STEP 2 · 훈련 (연결고리 잇기)평가원 2023학년도 6월 37번 · #147
지시어연결어시간·순서 만 표시 — 노랑 형광펜은 쓰지 않아요
In economics, there is a principle known as the sunk cost fallacy. The idea is that when you are invested and have ownership in something, you overvalue that thing. (B) This leads people to continue on paths or pursuits that should clearly be abandoned. (A) Sometimes, the smartest thing a person can do is quit. Although this is true, it has also become a tired and played-out argument. Sunk cost doesn’t always have to be a bad thing. (C) Actually, you can leverage this human tendency to your benefit.
🔗 연결고리로 순서를 잇는 과정 (노랑 형광펜이 아니라 지시어·연결어·시간으로 조각을 연결)
This leads people to continue on paths지시어(B)의 'This'는 주어진 글의 '투자한 것을 과대평가하는 성향'을 받음 — 주어진 글 바로 뒤
For example, people often remain in terrible relationships연결어(B)가 그 성향의 나쁜 사례(관계·사업)를 예시
Sunk cost doesn’t always have to be a bad thing대응·반복(A)가 (B)의 '나쁜 것' 사례를 전환 — '항상 나쁘진 않다'
Actually, you can leverage this human tendency연결어(C)의 'Actually'가 (A)의 '나쁘지만은 않다'를 이어받아 '오히려 활용 가능' — (A) 뒤
  1. 1주어진 글: 매몰비용 오류 — 투자·소유하면 그것을 과대평가함
  2. 2(B): 'This leads people to continue ...'로 그 성향이 '버려야 할 것도 계속하게 함'(나쁜 예시)
  3. 3(A): 'Sunk cost doesn’t always have to be a bad thing'으로 전환
  4. 4(C): 'Actually, you can leverage this human tendency'로 활용법 제시 → (B)-(A)-(C)
→ 정답: (B)-(A)-(C)
순서·삽입은 '중요 문장'이 아니라 이어주는 단서(고리)로 푼다.
①(A)-(C)-(B)✘ 없음

(B)

→ 주어진 글 뒤 (This가 앞의 '과대평가 성향'을 받아 그 나쁜 결과로 이어짐)

37글의 순서 평가원 2023학년도 9월 37번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 노랑 형광펜이 아니라 각 조각의 지시어·연결어·시간 표현을 표시해 이어보세요.
Culture operates in ways we can consciously consider and discuss but also in ways of which we are far less cognizant. (A) In some cases, however, we are far less aware of why we believe a certain claim to be true, or how we are to explain why certain social realities exist. Ideas about the social world become part of our worldview without our necessarily being aware of the source of the particular idea or that we even hold the idea at all. (B) When we have to offer an account of our actions, we consciously understand which excuses might prove acceptable, given the particular circumstances we find ourselves in. In such situations, we use cultural ideas as we would use a particular tool. (C) We select the cultural notion as we would select a screwdriver: certain jobs call for a Phillips head while others require an Allen wrench. Whichever idea we insert into the conversation to justify our actions, the point is that our motives are discursively available to us. They are not hidden.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
① (A) －(C) －(B)② (B) －(A) －(C)③ (B) －(C) －(A)④ (C) －(A) －(B)⑤ (C) －(B) －(A)

지시어 this·that연결어 However·So연대·순서

Culture operates in ways we can consciously consider and discuss but also in ways of which we are far less cognizant.

🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 노랑 형광펜이 아니라 각 조각의 지시어·연결어·시간 표현을 표시해 이어보세요.
Wildfire is a natural phenomenon in many Australian environments. The intentional setting of fire to manage the landscape was practised by Aboriginal people for millennia. (A) However, the pattern of burning that stockmen introduced was unlike previous regimes. When conditions allowed, they would set fire to the landscape as they moved their animals out for the winter. This functioned to clear woody vegetation and also stimulated new plant growth in the following spring. (B) Although grasses were the first kinds of plants to recolonize the burnt areas they were soon succeeded by further woody plants and shrubs. About the only strategy to prevent such regrowth was further burning ― essentially using fire to control the consequences of using fire. (C) The young shoots were a ready food source for their animals when they returned. However, the practice also tended to reinforce the scrubby growth it was intended to control.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
④ (B)⑤ (A)

주어진 글
첫머리 단서 없음
Wildfire is a natural phenomenon in many Australian environments. The intentional setting of fire to manage the landscape was practised by Aboriginal people for millennia.
산불은 호주의 많은 환경에서 자연 현상이다. 경관 관리를 위해 의도적으로 불을 놓는 일은 원주민이 수천 년간 행해 왔다.

However, the pattern of burning that stockmen introduced was unlike previous regimes. ... stimulated new plant growth in the following spring.
그러나 목축업자가 도입한 방화 방식은 이전 양식과 달랐다. 여건이 되면 겨울에 가축을 내보내며 불을 놓았고, 이는 목본 식생을 제거하고 이듬해 봄 새 식물 성장을 촉진했다.
→ 주어진 글 뒤 (However가 원주민의 옛 방식과 목축업자의 새 방식을 대조)

The young shoots were a ready food source for their animals when they returned. However, the practice also tended to reinforce the scrubby growth it was intended to control.
그 어린 싹은 가축이 돌아왔을 때 즉시 먹을 수 있는 먹이가 되었다. 그러나 그 관행은 억제하려던 관목 성장을 오히려 강화하는 경향도 있었다.
