The generally close connection between health and what animals want exists because wanting to obtain the right things and wanting to avoid the wrong ones are major ways in which animals keep themselves healthy. They can take pre-emptive action so that the worst never happens. They start to want things that will be necessary for their health and survival not for now but for some time in the future. Animals have evolved many different ways of maintaining their health and then regaining it again once it has been damaged, such as an ability to heal wounds when they are injured and an amazingly complex immune system for warding off infection. Animals are equally good, however, at dealing with injury and disease before they even happen. They have evolved a complex set of mechanisms for anticipating and avoiding danger altogether.

🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 노랑 형광펜이 아니라 각 조각의 지시어·연결어·시간 표현을 표시해 이어보세요.
A good example of chaos is the magnetic pendulum sold as an executive toy. It has four magnets arranged in a square at the base and a pendulum that swings back and forth between them. In order to produce chaos, the iteration has to be within what is called a nonlinear system. Nor are all nonlinear systems chaotic: to become so they need to be pushed beyond a certain point, called a bifurcation. Before that point is reached they may behave in a quite orderly fashion. Release the pendulum and note the magnets that it visits, and in what order. If the pendulum is released from the same position a second time, the pattern of movement may at first be the same but soon it will become completely different. In fact, the pattern of its movement is chaotic. No matter how much care is taken to start the pendulum in the same position, it will visit an entirely different set of points on the two occasions. Chaotic systems are generated by iteration, though not all iteration leads to chaos.

There are a number of human resource management practices that are necessary to support organizational learning. (A) Their role should be to assist, consult, and advise teams on how best to approach learning. They must be able to develop new mechanisms for cross-training peers ― team members ― and new systems for capturing and sharing information. To do this, human resource development professionals must be able to think systematically and understand how to promote learning within groups and across the organization. (B) For example, performance evaluation and reward systems that reinforce long-term performance and the development and sharing of new skills and knowledge are particularly important. In addition, the human resource development function may be dramatically changed to keep the emphasis on continuous learning. (C) In a learning organization, every employee must take the responsibility for acquiring and transferring knowledge. Formal training programs, developed in advance and delivered according to a preset schedule, are insufficient to address shifting training needs and encourage timely information sharing. Rather, human resource development professionals must become learning facilitators.

36글의 순서 평가원 2022학년도 6월 36번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 노랑 형광펜이 아니라 각 조각의 지시어·연결어·시간 표현을 표시해 이어보세요.
Spatial reference points are larger than themselves. This isn’t really a paradox: landmarks are themselves, but they also define neighborhoods around themselves. In a paradigm that has been repeated on many campuses, researchers first collect a list of campus landmarks from students. Then they ask another group of students to estimate the distances between pairs of locations, some to landmarks, some to ordinary buildings on campus. This asymmetry of distance estimates violates the most elementary principles of Euclidean distance, that the distance from A to B must be the same as the distance from B to A. Judgments of distance, then, are not necessarily coherent. The remarkable finding is that distances from an ordinary location to a landmark are judged shorter than distances from a landmark to an ordinary location. So, people would judge the distance from Pierre’s house to the Eiffel Tower to be shorter than the distance from the Eiffel Tower to Pierre’s house. Like black holes, landmarks seem to pull ordinary locations toward themselves, but ordinary places do not.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

36글의 순서STEP 3 · 해석 (조각 잇기)🔗 지시어·이음매
🔗 조각별 해석 — 지시어가 가리키는 것과 어디에 붙는지로 순서를 확인
주어진 글
첫머리 단서 없음
Spatial reference points are larger than themselves. This isn’t really a paradox: landmarks are themselves, but they also define neighborhoods around themselves.
공간적 기준점은 자기 자신보다 크다. 랜드마크는 자기 자신이면서 동시에 주변 이웃 영역을 규정한다.
시작
(A)
researchers first collect a list of campus landmarks→ 주어진 글의 '랜드마크'를 실제 실험 소재로 받아 거리 추정 실험을 설정
In a paradigm that has been repeated on many campuses, researchers first collect a list of campus landmarks from students. Then they ask another group of students to estimate the distances between pairs of locations, some to landmarks, some to ordinary buildings on campus.
여러 캠퍼스에서 반복된 실험에서 연구자들은 먼저 학생들에게서 랜드마크 목록을 모으고, 다른 학생들에게 장소 쌍 사이의 거리를 추정하게 한다.
→ 주어진 글 뒤 (랜드마크 개념을 받아 실험 절차를 도입)
(C)
The remarkable finding→ (A)에서 학생들이 거리 추정을 한 그 실험의 '결과'
The remarkable finding is that distances from an ordinary location to a landmark are judged shorter than distances from a landmark to an ordinary location. So, people would judge the distance from Pierre’s house to the Eiffel Tower to be shorter than the distance from the Eiffel Tower to Pierre’s house. Like black holes, landmarks seem to pull ordinary locations toward themselves, but ordinary places do not.
놀라운 발견은 보통 장소에서 랜드마크까지의 거리가 랜드마크에서 보통 장소까지의 거리보다 더 짧게 판단된다는 것이다. 랜드마크는 보통 장소를 자기 쪽으로 끌어당기는 듯하다.
→ (A) 뒤 (The remarkable finding이 (A) 실험의 결과를 제시)
(B)
This asymmetry of distance estimates→ (C)의 '한 방향 거리가 더 짧게 판단되는' 비대칭적 결과
This asymmetry of distance estimates violates the most elementary principles of Euclidean distance, that the distance from A to B must be the same as the distance from B to A. Judgments of distance, then, are not necessarily coherent.
이 거리 추정의 비대칭성은 A→B 거리와 B→A 거리가 같아야 한다는 유클리드 거리의 기본 원리를 위반한다. 따라서 거리 판단은 반드시 일관적이지는 않다.
→ (C) 뒤 (This asymmetry가 (C)의 비대칭 결과를 받아 결론)
→ 정답: (A)-(C)-(B)
①정답 (A)실험 설정→(C)The remarkable finding 결과→(B)This asymmetry 참조 · ②③④⑤ 지시어 연결 어긋남
🔁재진술 지도 재진술 연결 문제 · 정답 패러프레이징
핵심(A)랜드마크로의 거리와 랜드마크로부터의 거리는 비대칭적으로 판단된다
같은 소재 A가 A→A′→A″→A‴로 표현만 바뀌며 되풀이 → 마지막이 정답 선지
Alandmarks ... also define neighborhoods around themselves랜드마크는 주변을 규정한다
A′↓전개The remarkable finding is that distances ... are judged shorter거리가 비대칭적으로 더 짧게 판단됨
정답실험 결과 '거리 판단의 비대칭'이 주어진 글의 랜드마크 성질을 구체화

37글의 순서 평가원 2022학년도 수능 37번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 노랑 형광펜이 아니라 각 조각의 지시어·연결어·시간 표현을 표시해 이어보세요.
In spite of the likeness between the fictional and real world, the fictional world deviates from the real one in one important respect. (A) The author has selected the content according to his own worldview and his own conception of relevance, in an attempt to be neutral and objective or convey a subjective view on the world. Whatever the motives, the author’s subjective conception of the world stands between the reader and the original, untouched world on which the story is based. (B) Because of the inner qualities with which the individual is endowed through heritage and environment, the mind functions as a filter; every outside impression that passes through it is filtered and interpreted. However, the world the reader encounters in literature is already processed and filtered by another consciousness. (C) The existing world faced by the individual is in principle an infinite chaos of events and details before it is organized by a human mind. This chaos only gets processed and modified when perceived by a human mind.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
① (A) －(C) －(B)② (B) －(A) －(C)③ (B) －(C) －(A)④ (C) －(A) －(B)⑤ (C) －(B) －(A)
🔗 연결고리 단서
지시어 this·that연결어 However·So연대·순서
✅ 셀프 체크
  • 각 조각의 첫 지시어·연결어를 표시했나?
  • 연대·인과로 사슬이 이어지나?
  • 대명사가 가리킬 선행어가 앞에 있나?
✍️ 내 풀이
걸린 시간
내가 고른 답
근거 문장(내 생각):
💡 글의 순서 팁
지시어·연결어(this·however·연대)로 흐름 잇기
🔁재진술 연결 문제추가 문제 재진술 1개 찾기
핵심 소재·주장(A)은 주어져 있다. 지문에서 그것을 다른 말로 바꾼 표현을 나온 만큼 A′→A″…로 찾아 잇는다. 실제 재진술만 — 없으면 잇지 않는다.
A핵심 소재·주장(주어짐)the world the reader encounters in literature is already ... filtered by another consciousness문학의 세계는 또 다른 의식이 걸러 놓은 것

likeness유사함, 닮음

heritage유산

37글의 순서STEP 2 · 훈련 (연결고리 잇기)평가원 2022학년도 수능 37번 · #154
지시어연결어시간·순서 만 표시 — 노랑 형광펜은 쓰지 않아요
In spite of the likeness between the fictional and real world, the fictional world deviates from the real one in one important respect. (A) The author has selected the content according to his own worldview and his own conception of relevance, in an attempt to be neutral and objective or convey a subjective view on the world. Whatever the motives, the author’s subjective conception of the world stands between the reader and the original, untouched world on which the story is based. (B) Because of the inner qualities with which the individual is endowed through heritage and environment, the mind functions as a filter; every outside impression that passes through it is filtered and interpreted. However, the world the reader encounters in literature is already processed and filtered by another consciousness. (C) The existing world faced by the individual is in principle an infinite chaos of events and details before it is organized by a human mind. This chaos only gets processed and modified when perceived by a human mind.
🔗 연결고리로 순서를 잇는 과정 (노랑 형광펜이 아니라 지시어·연결어·시간으로 조각을 연결)
another consciousness지시어(B) 끝의 'another consciousness'는 (A)의 'The author'로 밝혀짐 — (A)가 (B) 뒤
The author has selected the content지시어(A)가 (B)의 '또 다른 의식'의 정체를 '저자'로 특정 — (B) 뒤
the mind functions as a filter대응·반복(B)가 (C)의 '인간 정신이 세계를 조직'을 '필터'로 이어받음 — (C) 뒤
However연결어(B)의 'However'가 '마음의 필터'에서 '문학 속 이미 걸러진 세계'로 전환
  1. 1주어진 글: 허구 세계는 한 가지 점에서 실제와 다르다 (차이 예고)
  2. 2(C): 실재 세계는 인간 정신이 조직하기 전엔 무한한 혼돈이라며 '정신의 처리'를 도입
  3. 3(B): 'the mind functions as a filter'로 이어받고 'However ... another consciousness'로 문학의 매개 의식을 제시
  4. 4(A): 'The author'가 그 'another consciousness'임을 밝혀 독자와 세계 사이에 놓임 → (C)-(B)-(A)
→ 정답: (C)-(B)-(A)
순서·삽입은 '중요 문장'이 아니라 이어주는 단서(고리)로 푼다.
①(A)-(C)-(B)✘ 연결 어긋남
②(B)-(A)-(C)✘ 연결 어긋남
③(B)-(C)-(A)✘ 연결 어긋남
④(C)-(A)-(B)✘ 연결 어긋남
⑤(C)-(B)-(A)✔ 근거

허구 세계와 실제 세계의 유사성에도 불구하고, 허구 세계는 한 가지 중요한 점에서 실제와 달라진다.

개인이 마주하는 실재 세계는 인간의 정신에 의해 조직되기 전에는 원리상 무한한 혼돈이다.

(B)
the mind functions as a filter→ (C)의 '인간의 정신이 세계를 조직·처리한다'는 내용을 이어 그 정신을 '필터'로 구체화
Because of the inner qualities ... the mind functions as a filter ... However, the world the reader encounters in literature is already processed and filtered by another consciousness.
마음은 필터로 기능한다. 그러나 문학에서 독자가 만나는 세계는 이미 또 다른 의식에 의해 걸러진 것이다.

(A)
The author→ (B) 끝의 'another consciousness(또 다른 의식)'의 정체 — 곧 '저자(author)'
The author has selected the content according to his own worldview ... the author’s subjective conception of the world stands between the reader and the original, untouched world.

[주어진 글] The most commonly known form of results-based pricing is a practice called contingency pricing, used by lawyers. (C) Contingency pricing is the major way that personal injury and certain consumer cases are billed. In this approach, lawyers do not receive fees or payment until the case is settled, when they are paid a percentage of the money that the client receives. (A) Therefore, only an outcome in the client’s favor is compensated. From the client’s point of view, the pricing makes sense in part because most clients in these cases are unfamiliar with and possibly intimidated by law firms. Their biggest fears are high fees for a case that may take years to settle. (B) By using contingency pricing, clients are ensured that they pay no fees until they receive a settlement. In these and other instances of contingency pricing, the economic value of the service is hard to determine before the service, and providers develop a price that allows them to share the risks and rewards of delivering value to the buyer.

Traditionally, when teachers teach writing, they assign topics for students to write on; perhaps they do a bit of brainstorming about the topic during a pre-writing phase, and then have students write about the topic without interruption. (C) Subsequently, teachers collect and evaluate what students have written. Such instruction is very ‘product-oriented;’ there is no involvement of the teacher in the act or ‘process’ of writing. (A) In process writing, on the other hand, students may initially brainstorm ideas about a topic and begin writing, but then they have repeated conferences with the teacher and the other students, during which they receive feedback on their writing up to that point, make revisions, based on the feedback they receive, and carry on writing. (B) In this way, students learn to view their writing as someone else’s reading and to improve both the expression of meaning and the form of their writing as they draft and redraft. Process writing shifts the emphasis in teaching writing from evaluation to revision.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
④ (B)⑤ (A)

37글의 순서 평가원 2024학년도 9월 37번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 노랑 형광펜이 아니라 각 조각의 지시어·연결어·시간 표현을 표시해 이어보세요.
Plants show finely tuned adaptive responses when nutrients are limiting. Gardeners may recognize yellow leaves as a sign of poor nutrition and the need for fertilizer. (A) In contrast, plants with a history of nutrient abundance are risk averse and save energy. At all developmental stages, plants respond to environmental changes or unevenness so as to be able to use their energy for growth, survival, and reproduction, while limiting damage and nonproductive uses of their valuable energy. (B) Research in this area has shown that plants are constantly aware of their position in the environment, in terms of both space and time. Plants that have experienced variable nutrient availability in the past tend to exhibit risk-taking behaviors, such as spending energy on root lengthening instead of leaf production. (C) But if a plant does not have a caretaker to provide supplemental minerals, it can proliferate or lengthen its roots and develop root hairs to allow foraging in more distant soil patches. Plants can also use their memory to respond to histories of temporal or spatial variation in nutrient or resource availability.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Perhaps at some point you have seen some mathematical writing and not understood it. But how do you recognise some writing is mathematical in the first place? (A) The complicated notations that might spring to mind ― all those strange dashes, squiggles and letters ― are obvious signs, but a lot of those are really quite modern. Mathematics had been going on for a long time before the dashes and squiggles were invented. (C) Put simply, there has to be something mathematical going on for us to say that it is mathematics. And if we are dealing with writing from a very distant past, in a language that is not familiar to us, from a time even before recorded language, that can be sometimes difficult to recognise.

36글의 순서 평가원 2022학년도 수능 36번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 노랑 형광펜이 아니라 각 조각의 지시어·연결어·시간 표현을 표시해 이어보세요.
According to the market response model, it is increasing prices that drive providers to search for new sources, innovators to substitute, consumers to conserve, and alternatives to emerge. (A) Many examples of such “green taxes” exist. Facing landfill costs, labor expenses, and related costs in the provision of garbage disposal, for example, some cities have required households to dispose of all waste in special trash bags, purchased by consumers themselves, and often costing a dollar or more each. (B) Taxing certain goods or services, and so increasing prices, should result in either decreased use of these resources or creative innovation of new sources or options. The money raised through the tax can be used directly by the government either to supply services or to search for alternatives. (C) The results have been greatly increased recycling and more careful attention by consumers to packaging and waste. By internalizing the costs of trash to consumers, there has been an observed decrease in the flow of garbage from households.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

36글의 순서STEP 2 · 훈련 (연결고리 잇기)평가원 2022학년도 수능 36번 · #160
지시어연결어시간·순서 만 표시 — 노랑 형광펜은 쓰지 않아요
According to the market response model, it is increasing prices that drive providers to search for new sources, innovators to substitute, consumers to conserve, and alternatives to emerge. (A) Many examples of such “green taxes” exist. Facing landfill costs, labor expenses, and related costs in the provision of garbage disposal, for example, some cities have required households to dispose of all waste in special trash bags, purchased by consumers themselves, and often costing a dollar or more each. (B) Taxing certain goods or services, and so increasing prices, should result in either decreased use of these resources or creative innovation of new sources or options. The money raised through the tax can be used directly by the government either to supply services or to search for alternatives. (C) The results have been greatly increased recycling and more careful attention by consumers to packaging and waste. By internalizing the costs of trash to consumers, there has been an observed decrease in the flow of garbage from households.
🔗 연결고리로 순서를 잇는 과정 (노랑 형광펜이 아니라 지시어·연결어·시간으로 조각을 연결)

The results have been지시어(C)의 'The results'가 (A) 예시 정책의 결과를 받음 → (A) 뒤
  1. 1주어진 글: 변화를 이끄는 것은 '가격 상승'이라는 논지 제시
  2. 2(B): 'and so increasing prices'로 과세→가격 상승 메커니즘을 이어받아 설명
  3. 3(A): 'such green taxes'의 사례(쓰레기봉투 유료화)를 for example로 제시
  4. 4(C): 'The results'로 그 사례의 결과(재활용 증가)를 서술 → (B)-(A)-(C)
→ 정답: (B)-(A)-(C)

🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 노랑 형광펜이 아니라 각 조각의 지시어·연결어·시간 표현을 표시해 이어보세요.
The fossil record provides evidence of evolution. The story the fossils tell is one of change. Creatures existed in the past that are no longer with us. Sequential changes are found in many fossils showing the change of certain features over time from a common ancestor. (C) Apart from demonstrating that evolution did occur, the fossil record also provides tests of the predictions made from evolutionary theory. For example, the theory predicts that single-celled organisms evolved before multicelled organisms. (B) The fossil record supports this prediction ―multicelled organisms are found in layers of earth millions of years after the first appearance of single-celled organisms. Note that the possibility always remains that the opposite could be found. (A) If multicelled organisms were indeed found to have evolved before single-celled organisms, then the theory of evolution would be rejected. A good scientific theory always allows for the possibility of rejection. The fact that we have not found such a case in countless examinations of the fossil record strengthens the case for evolutionary theory.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Negotiation can be defined as an attempt to explore and reconcile conflicting positions in order to reach an acceptable outcome. (C) Whatever the nature of the outcome, which may actually favour one party more than another, the purpose of negotiation is the identification of areas of common interest and conflict. In this sense, depending on the intentions of the parties, the areas of common interest may be clarified, refined and given negotiated form and substance. (A) Areas of difference can and do frequently remain, and will perhaps be the subject of future negotiations, or indeed remain irreconcilable. In those instances in which the parties have highly antagonistic or polarised relations, the process is likely to be dominated by the exposition, very often in public, of the areas of conflict. (B) In these and sometimes other forms of negotiation, negotiation serves functions other than reconciling conflicting interests. These will include delay, publicity, diverting attention or seeking intelligence about the other party and its negotiating position.

36글의 순서STEP 2 · 훈련 (연결고리 잇기)평가원 2024학년도 수능 36번 · #162
지시어연결어시간·순서 만 표시 — 노랑 형광펜은 쓰지 않아요
Negotiation can be defined as an attempt to explore and reconcile conflicting positions in order to reach an acceptable outcome. (C) Whatever the nature of the outcome, which may actually favour one party more than another, the purpose of negotiation is the identification of areas of common interest and conflict. In this sense, depending on the intentions of the parties, the areas of common interest may be clarified, refined and given negotiated form and substance. (A) Areas of difference can and do frequently remain, and will perhaps be the subject of future negotiations, or indeed remain irreconcilable. In those instances in which the parties have highly antagonistic or polarised relations, the process is likely to be dominated by the exposition, very often in public, of the areas of conflict. (B) In these and sometimes other forms of negotiation, negotiation serves functions other than reconciling conflicting interests. These will include delay, publicity, diverting attention or seeking intelligence about the other party and its negotiating position.
🔗 연결고리로 순서를 잇는 과정 (노랑 형광펜이 아니라 지시어·연결어·시간으로 조각을 연결)
the purpose of negotiation is the identification of areas of common interest and conflict대응·반복(C) — 주어진 글의 협상 '정의'를 곧바로 '목적'으로 이어받아 부연하므로 주어진 글 뒤
In this sense연결어(C) 후반 — 앞의 정의를 정리·심화하는 연결로, (C)가 도입부임을 뒷받침
Areas of difference대응·반복(A) 첫머리 — (C)의 'areas of common interest and conflict' 중 conflict(차이)를 되받아 남는 이견을 설명 → (C) 뒤
In these and sometimes other forms of negotiation지시어(B) 첫머리 — 'these forms'가 (A)의 적대적·양극화된 관계에서의 협상 형태를 가리킴 → (A) 뒤
  1. 1주어진 글이 협상을 '대립 입장을 조정하는 시도'로 정의
  2. 2(C)가 그 정의를 '협상의 목적=공통·갈등 영역의 식별'로 이어받아 부연
  3. 3(A)가 (C)의 '갈등(차이)' 영역을 되받아, 남는 이견과 적대적 관계의 협상을 설명
  4. 4(B)의 'these forms'가 (A)의 그 협상 형태를 가리키며 다른 기능을 마무리 → (C)-(A)-(B)
→ 정답: (C)-(A)-(B)
순서·삽입은 '중요 문장'이 아니라 이어주는 단서(고리)로 푼다.
①(A)-(C)-(B)✘ 없음
②(B)-(A)-(C)✘ 없음
③(B)-(C)-(A)✘ 없음
④(C)-(A)-(B)✔ 근거
⑤(C)-(B)-(A)✘ 없음

주어진 글
첫머리 단서 없음
Negotiation can be defined as an attempt to explore and reconcile conflicting positions in order to reach an acceptable outcome.
협상은 수용 가능한 결과에 도달하기 위해 대립하는 입장들을 탐색하고 조정하려는 시도로 정의될 수 있다.
시작
(C)
the purpose of negotiation→ 주어진 글의 '협상 = 대립 입장을 조정하려는 시도'라는 정의(를 목적으로 이어받음)
Whatever the nature of the outcome, which may actually favour one party more than another, the purpose of negotiation is the identification of areas of common interest and conflict.
결과의 성격이 어떠하든 ― 실제로 어느 한쪽에 더 유리할 수도 있지만 ― 협상의 목적은 공통 이해관계와 갈등의 영역을 식별하는 것이다.
→ 주어진 글 뒤
(A)
Areas of difference→ (C)의 '공통 이해관계와 갈등(차이)의 영역' 중 갈등(차이) 영역
Areas of difference can and do frequently remain, and will perhaps be the subject of future negotiations, or indeed remain irreconcilable.
차이(이견)의 영역은 흔히 남을 수 있고 실제로 자주 남으며, 아마도 향후 협상의 대상이 되거나, 정말로 조정 불가능한 채로 남기도 한다.
→ (C) 뒤
(B)
In these ... forms of negotiation→ (A)의 '적대적·양극화된 관계에서 갈등을 드러내는 협상 형태'
In these and sometimes other forms of negotiation, negotiation serves functions other than reconciling conflicting interests.
이러한, 그리고 때로는 다른 형태의 협상에서, 협상은 대립하는 이해관계를 조정하는 것 이외의 기능을 수행한다.
→ (A) 뒤
→ 정답: (C)-(A)-(B)

핵심(A)협상은 공통 이익과 갈등 영역을 확인하는 과정이다.
같은 소재 A가 A→A′→A″→A‴로 표현만 바뀌며 되풀이 → 마지막이 정답 선지

If we take an evolutionary look at our beginnings, we see a life in which high levels of physical activity were required for survival. (C) Even one century ago, most people needed to be physically active to work, to travel, and to take care of homes and families. Our modern world has engineered such activity out of our lives. (A) There are fewer manual jobs, we do not need to travel on foot, we do not need to hunt and harvest for our food, and many domestic chores have been mechanized. While these changes have created many benefits for our longevity and quality of life, they have also created many problems. (B) Lack of sufficient physical activity has now been linked to at least 17 unhealthy conditions, almost all of which are chronic diseases or considered risk factors for chronic diseases. Adrianne Hardman has summarized this serious situation for public health: “Physical inactivity is a waste of human potential for health and well-being.”
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 노랑 형광펜이 아니라 각 조각의 지시어·연결어·시간 표현을 표시해 이어보세요.
The growing complexity of computer software has direct implications for our global safety and security, particularly as the physical objects upon which we depend ― things like cars, airplanes, bridges, tunnels, and implantable medical devices ― transform themselves into computer code. As all this code grows in size and complexity, so too do the number of errors and software bugs. According to a study by Carnegie Mellon University, commercial software typically has twenty to thirty bugs for every thousand lines of code ― 50 million lines of code means 1 million to 1.5 million potential errors to be exploited. This is the basis for all malware attacks that take advantage of these computer bugs to get the code to do something it was not originally intended to do. As computer code grows more elaborate, software bugs flourish and security suffers, with increasing consequences for society at large. Physical things are increasingly becoming information technologies. Cars are “computers we ride in,” and airplanes are nothing more than “flying Solaris boxes attached to bucketfuls of industrial control systems.”
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

37글의 순서 3점평가원 2024학년도 6월 37번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️

Darwin saw blushing as uniquely human, representing an involuntary physical reaction caused by embarrassment and self-consciousness in a social environment. Maybe our brief loss of face benefits the long-term cohesion of the group. Interestingly, if someone blushes after making a social mistake, they are viewed in a more favourable light than those who don’t blush. If we feel awkward, embarrassed or ashamed when we are alone, we don’t blush; it seems to be caused by our concern about what others are thinking of us. Studies have confirmed that simply being told you are blushing brings it on. We feel as though others can see through our skin and into our mind. However, while we sometimes want to disappear when we involuntarily go bright red, psychologists argue that blushing actually serves a positive social purpose. When we blush, it’s a signal to others that we recognize that a social norm has been broken; it is an apology for a faux pas.

The potential for market enforcement is greater when contracting parties have developed reputational capital that can be devalued when contracts are violated. (A) Similarly, a landowner can undermaintain fences, ditches, and irrigation systems. Accurate assessments of farmer and landowner behavior will be made over time, and those farmers and landowners who attempt to gain at each other’s expense will find that others may refuse to deal with them in the future. (B) Over time landowners indirectly monitor farmers by observing the reported output, the general quality of the soil, and any unusual or extreme behavior. Farmer and landowner reputations act as a bond. In any growing season a farmer can reduce effort, overuse soil, or underreport the crop. (C) Farmers and landowners develop reputations for honesty, fairness, producing high yields, and consistently demonstrating that they are good at what they do. In small, close-knit farming communities, reputations are well known.

The potential for market enforcement is greater when contracting parties have developed reputational capital that can be devalued when contracts are violated.

36글의 순서 평가원 2027학년도 6월 36번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 노랑 형광펜이 아니라 각 조각의 지시어·연결어·시간 표현을 표시해 이어보세요.
Plants have evolved defenses almost as diverse as the number of genera. Some load their tissues with harsh compounds that either are unpleasant to insects or intoxicate them, encouraging the insects to go bother another plant or at least slowing down their eating. (A) The back-and-forth is not a matter of natural balance, but more like a drawn-out evolutionary conversation. New plant defenses unintentionally select for insects with ways to get around them, which in turn help bring about more resilient and resistant plant species. New variations, shading into entire new forms and adaptations, maintain the stalemate. (B) Plants can release chemical compounds that let their same-species neighbors know that an attack is likely coming, pushing those nearby plants to start building up defensive compounds in their tissues. Some of these cues even attract insect predators, a call for an assist that benefits both the plant and its bug-eating collaborators. (C) Structural defenses like thick coats of wax on leaves may prevent some insect species from damaging the plant tissues altogether. Nor are individual plants entirely on their own while under attack.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
④ (B)⑤ (A)

🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 노랑 형광펜이 아니라 각 조각의 지시어·연결어·시간 표현을 표시해 이어보세요.
When two natural bodies of water stand at different levels, building a canal between them presents a complicated engineering problem. (A) Then the upper gates open and the ship passes through. For downstream passage, the process works the opposite way. The ship enters the lock from the upper level, and water is pumped from the lock until the ship is in line with the lower level. (B) When a vessel is going upstream, the upper gates stay closed as the ship enters the lock at the lower water level. The downstream gates are then closed and more water is pumped into the basin. The rising water lifts the vessel to the level of the upper body of water. (C) To make up for the difference in level, engineers build one or more water “steps,” called locks, that carry ships or boats up or down between the two levels. A lock is an artificial water basin. It has a long rectangular shape with concrete walls and a pair of gates at each end.
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

🔗 조각별 해석 — 지시어가 가리키는 것과 어디에 붙는지로 순서를 확인
주어진 글
첫머리 단서 없음
When two natural bodies of water stand at different levels, building a canal between them presents a complicated engineering problem.
두 자연 수계가 서로 다른 높이에 있을 때, 그 사이에 운하를 건설하는 것은 복잡한 공학 문제를 제기한다.
시작 — '다른 높이(수위 차)'라는 문제 제시
(C)
To make up for the difference in level→ 주어진 글의 '서로 다른 높이(수위 차)' 문제
To make up for the difference in level, engineers build one or more water “steps,” called locks ... a pair of gates at each end.
그 높이 차를 메꾸기 위해 기술자들은 갑문(lock)이라 불리는 물 ‘계단’을 만들며, 각 끝에 한 쌍의 문이 있다.
→ 주어진 글 뒤 (수위 차를 메꾸는 갑문·문 구조를 처음 도입)
(B)
the upper gates→ (C)에서 소개된 '각 끝의 문(gates)'과 갑문 구조
When a vessel is going upstream, the upper gates stay closed ... The rising water lifts the vessel to the level of the upper body of water.
선박이 상류로 갈 때 상류 문은 닫힌 채로 배가 낮은 수위에서 갑문에 들어오고, 물이 차오르며 배를 상위 수면까지 들어올린다.
→ (C) 뒤 (C)가 정의한 갑문·문으로 상류 통행 절차를 설명)
(A)
Then→ (B)의 '물이 차올라 배를 상위 수면으로 들어올린' 직후 순간
Then the upper gates open and the ship passes through. For downstream passage, the process works the opposite way.
그러면 상류 문이 열리고 배가 통과한다. 하류 통행은 그 과정이 반대로 이루어진다.
→ (B) 뒤 (Then이 (B)의 물이 차온 뒤 '문이 열림'으로 이어짐)
→ 정답: (C)-(B)-(A)

1-PASS

문장 삽입을 '한 번에' 푸는 법

형광펜 독해 · 유형 특강
왜 자꾸 여러 번 읽게 될까? — 조각의 '내용'을 이해하려 읽기 때문. 순서·삽입은 이해 문제가 아니라 '어디에 붙나'를 잇는 문제다. 읽는 목적을 “무슨 말이지?” → “어디에 붙지?” 로 바꾸면 한 번의 전진 읽기로 끝난다.
삽입 — 한 번에 푸는 3단계
STEP 1넣을 문장 먼저 · 손잡이 둘뒤 손잡이(지시어 this·they·But → 앞에 뭐가 있어야) + 앞 손잡이(새 화제 → 뒤에 뭐가 와야).
STEP 2한 번 훑어 끊긴 곳본문을 딱 한 번 훑으며 흐름이 끊긴 한 군데(대명사가 받을 게 없거나 화제가 튀는 곳)를 찾는다.
STEP 3끊긴 자리 = 정답손잡이를 쥐고 들어가니 다섯 자리를 시험하지 않는다.
시범 — 손잡이 뽑고 '끊긴 곳' 한 번에
넣을 문장의 손잡이(지시어)를 먼저 뽑고, 본문에서 흐름이 끊긴 한 곳만 찾는다. (2024학년도 6월 39번)
단서 색: 지시어시간·순서연결어
넣을 문장
As a result, they are fit and grow better, but they aren’t particularly long-lived.
손잡이they = 앞의 'Some individuals'(홀로 광합성하는 그 나무들) → 그 문장 뒤에 놓여야
① 앞 문장
Some individuals photosynthesize like mad until sugar positively bubbles …
이음매여기서 흐름이 끊김 — 'they'가 받을 대상이 바로 여기 → 이 뒤(②)가 자리
② 뒤 문장
This is because a tree can be only as strong as the forest …
이음매This = 넣을 문장의 '오래 못 산다'는 결과 → 그 이유를 이어 공백을 메움
넣을 문장의 they를 쥐고 본문을 한 번 훑자 ② 자리에서 딱 걸림 (다섯 자리 안 넣어봄).  ∴ 정답 ②
재독을 없애는 습관 3
  1. 묻는 것 먼저 — 주어진 글·넣을 문장부터. 갈고리를 쥐고 본문에 들어가면 되돌아갈 일이 없다.
  2. 몸통 말고 이음매 — 조각의 끝과 다음 첫머리만. 가운데 문장은 순서 판단에 필요 없다.
  3. 눈으로 외우지 말고 손으로 표시 — 지시어→선행어를 화살표로 그으며 간다.

문장 삽입
38-39번대 · 실제 기출 28문항
유형 공식지시어·연결어·시간으로 조각을 잇는다 (노랑 형광펜 아님)
이렇게 접근한다주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)가 가리킬 선행어 자리, 그리고 흐름이 끊긴 곳을 찾는다. 지시어 추적이 열쇠다.
🔎 지시어 잡는 법 — 이 유형의 열쇠
  • this/that/these + 명사 → 바로 앞에 그 명사·개념이 있어야 함
  • it/they/them → 수(단·복수) 맞는 가장 가까운 앞 명사
  • such · the same · another → '먼저 나온 것'이 전제
  • 핵심: 지시어는 늘 '앞'을 가리킨다. 선행어가 앞에 없으면 그 자리엔 못 온다.
🚫 오답 찍기 방지 체크
  • 넣을 문장의 지시어부터 → 선행어 있는 위치 뒤만 후보
  • 넣기 전·후 both 읽어 흐름 끊김 확인
  • 연결어·지시어가 갑자기 튀는 곳이 정답
✏️ 지시어 미니 드릴 — 밑줄이 가리키는 것은?
Robots now handle many factory jobs. These changes worry some workers. → robots handling factory jobs
She solved the puzzle in seconds. Such speed amazed everyone. → solving the puzzle in seconds
The city built three new parks. They soon became popular. → the three new parks

지시어 they·this역접 However논리 공백

39문장 삽입 평가원 2022학년도 6월 39번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)가 가리킬 자리와 흐름이 끊긴 곳을 찾으세요.
삽입할 문장This is particularly true since one aspect of sleep is decreased responsiveness to the environment.
The role that sleep plays in evolution is still under study. ( ① ) One possibility is that it is an advantageous adaptive state of decreased metabolism for an animal when there are no more pressing activities. ( ② ) This seems true for deeper states of inactivity such as hibernation during the winter when there are few food supplies, and a high metabolic cost to maintaining adequate temperature. ( ③ ) It may be true in daily situations as well, for instance for a prey species to avoid predators after dark. ( ④ ) On the other hand, the apparent universality of sleep, and the observation that mammals such as cetaceans have developed such highly complex mechanisms to preserve sleep on at least one side of the brain at a time, suggests that sleep additionally provides some vital service(s) for the organism. ( ⑤ ) If sleep is universal even when this potential price must be paid, the implication may be that it has important functions that cannot be obtained just by quiet, wakeful resting.
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

삽입할 문장This is particularly true since one aspect of sleep is decreased responsiveness to the environment.
The role that sleep plays in evolution is still under study. ( ① ) One possibility is that it is an advantageous adaptive state of decreased metabolism for an animal when there are no more pressing activities. ( ② ) This seems true for deeper states of inactivity such as hibernation during the winter when there are few food supplies, and a high metabolic cost to maintaining adequate temperature. ( ③ ) It may be true in daily situations as well, for instance for a prey species to avoid predators after dark. ( ④ ) On the other hand, the apparent universality of sleep, and the observation that mammals such as cetaceans have developed such highly complex mechanisms to preserve sleep on at least one side of the brain at a time, suggests that sleep additionally provides some vital service(s) for the organism. ( ⑤ ) If sleep is universal even when this potential price must be paid, the implication may be that it has important functions that cannot be obtained just by quiet, wakeful resting.
🔗 연결고리로 넣을 자리를 찾는 과정 (노랑 형광펜이 아니라 지시어·연결어·시간으로 조각을 연결)
suggests that sleep additionally provides some vital service(s)대응·반복④ 문장 — '수면이 중요 기능을 준다'는 내용을 넣을 문장의 'This is particularly true'가 받음
decreased responsiveness to the environment대응·반복넣을 문장이 도입하는 '대가' — 뒤 문장의 'this potential price'가 이를 받음
this potential price지시어⑤ 뒤 문장 — 'this potential price'가 넣을 문장의 'decreased responsiveness'(대가)를 받아야 성립 — 넣을 문장 뒤
On the other hand연결어④의 'On the other hand'가 ①~③의 적응 상태 가설과 대조로 '수면은 중요 기능' 도입, 그 뒤에 삽입문이 음
  1. 1④: 'On the other hand'로 수면의 보편성·고래류 사례를 들어 '수면이 중요한 기능을 준다' 제시
  2. 2넣을 문장: 'This is particularly true since ... decreased responsiveness'로 그 내용을 받고 '반응성 저하'라는 대가를 도입
  3. 3⑤ 뒤: 'If sleep is universal even when this potential price must be paid'의 'this potential price'가 그 대가를 받음 → ⑤에 삽입
→ 정답: ⑤
순서·삽입은 '중요 문장'이 아니라 이어주는 단서(고리)로 푼다.

②② One possibility ... / This seems true for ... hibernation✘ 연결 없음
③③ This seems true ... / It may be true in daily situations✘ 연결 없음
④④ It may be true ... / On the other hand, the apparent universality✘ 연결 없음
⑤⑤ On the other hand ... vital service(s) / If sleep is universal even when this potential price✔ 근거

39문장 삽입STEP 3 · 해석 (조각 잇기)🔗 지시어·이음매
🔗 조각별 해석 — 넣을 문장의 지시어가 앞을 받아 끊긴 흐름을 메우는지 확인
넣을 문장
This→ ④의 '수면이 개체에게 중요한 기능을 제공한다는 점(위험을 감수하면서도)'
This is particularly true since one aspect of sleep is decreased responsiveness to the environment.
수면의 한 측면이 환경에 대한 반응성 저하이기 때문에 이것은 특히 그러하다.
→ ④(수면이 중요 기능 제공) 뒤. '반응성 저하'라는 대가를 도입해 뒤 문장의 'this potential price'가 받을 대상을 만듦
앞 문장
On the other hand→ ①~③의 '수면=대사 저하의 적응 상태' 가설과 대조
On the other hand, the apparent universality of sleep, ... suggests that sleep additionally provides some vital service(s) for the organism.
반면에, 수면의 명백한 보편성과 고래류 같은 포유류가 고도로 복잡한 기제를 발달시켰다는 관찰은 수면이 개체에 중요한 기능을 제공함을 시사한다.
→ 넣을 문장 앞. '수면이 중요 기능을 준다'는 내용을 넣을 문장의 'This'가 받음
뒤 문장
this potential price→ 넣을 문장의 'decreased responsiveness to the environment(반응성 저하=치러야 할 대가)'
If sleep is universal even when this potential price must be paid, the implication may be that it has important functions ...
이 잠재적 대가를 치러야 할 때조차 수면이 보편적이라면, 그것은 조용히 깨어 쉬는 것만으로는 얻을 수 없는 중요한 기능을 함을 암시한다.
→ 넣을 문장 뒤. 'this potential price'가 삽입문의 '반응성 저하(대가)'를 받아야 성립
→ 정답: ⑤
⑤정답 ④ '수면이 중요 기능을 준다' 뒤에서 삽입문이 '대가(반응성 저하)'를 도입, 뒤 문장 'this potential price'가 이를 받음 · ①②③④ 'price'의 지시 대상 아직 없음

삽입할 문장Retraining current employees for new positions within the company will also greatly reduce their fear of being laid off.
Introduction of robots into factories, while employment of human workers is being reduced, creates worry and fear. ( ①) It is the responsibility of management to prevent or, at least, to ease these fears. ( ②) For example, robots could be introduced only in new plants rather than replacing humans in existing assembly lines. ( ③) Workers should be included in the planning for new factories or the introduction of robots into existing plants, so they can participate in the process. ( ④) It may be that robots are needed to reduce manufacturing costs so that the company remains competitive, but planning for such cost reductions should be done jointly by labor and management. ( ⑤) Since robots are particularly good at highly repetitive simple motions, the replaced human workers should be moved to positions where judgment and decisions beyond the abilities of robots are required.

38문장 삽입STEP 2 · 훈련 (연결고리 잇기)평가원 2022학년도 수능 38번 · #170
지시어연결어시간·순서 만 표시 — 노랑 형광펜은 쓰지 않아요
삽입할 문장Retraining current employees for new positions within the company will also greatly reduce their fear of being laid off.
Introduction of robots into factories, while employment of human workers is being reduced, creates worry and fear. ( ①) It is the responsibility of management to prevent or, at least, to ease these fears. ( ②) For example, robots could be introduced only in new plants rather than replacing humans in existing assembly lines. ( ③) Workers should be included in the planning for new factories or the introduction of robots into existing plants, so they can participate in the process. ( ④) It may be that robots are needed to reduce manufacturing costs so that the company remains competitive, but planning for such cost reductions should be done jointly by labor and management. ( ⑤) Since robots are particularly good at highly repetitive simple motions, the replaced human workers should be moved to positions where judgment and decisions beyond the abilities of robots are required.
🔗 연결고리로 넣을 자리를 찾는 과정 (노랑 형광펜이 아니라 지시어·연결어·시간으로 조각을 연결)
also연결어넣을 문장의 'also'는 앞서 나온 두려움 완화 조치에 재교육을 '추가' — 완화책이 이미 제시된 뒤여야 함
the replaced human workers should be moved to positions대응·반복⑤ 문장이 넣을 문장의 '새 직무로의 재교육/재배치'를 구체화 — 넣을 문장 바로 뒤
to ease these fears대응·반복글 전체가 로봇 도입의 '두려움 완화'를 다룸 — 넣을 문장의 'reduce their fear'와 대응
Since robots are particularly good at highly repetitive simple motions연결어⑤의 'Since'가 재배치의 이유를 대며 넣을 문장의 재교육을 부연
  1. 1도입: 로봇 도입이 노동자에게 걱정과 두려움을 일으킴
  2. 2①~④: 경영진이 두려움을 덜어야 하며(①) 신설 공장 도입·공동 계획 등 완화책 제시
  3. 3넣을 문장: 'also'로 '새 직무 재교육도 해고 두려움을 크게 줄인다'는 조치를 추가
  4. 4⑤: 'Since ... the replaced human workers should be moved to positions ...'로 그 재교육/재배치를 부연 → ⑤에 삽입
→ 정답: ⑤
순서·삽입은 '중요 문장'이 아니라 이어주는 단서(고리)로 푼다.
①①✘ 연결 어긋남
②②✘ 연결 어긋남
③③✘ 연결 어긋남
④④✘ 연결 어긋남
⑤⑤✔ 근거

38문장 삽입STEP 3 · 해석 (조각 잇기)🔗 지시어·이음매
🔗 조각별 해석 — 넣을 문장의 지시어가 앞을 받아 끊긴 흐름을 메우는지 확인
넣을 문장
also→ 앞서 제시된 '두려움을 완화하는(경영진이 fears를 덜어 줄) 조치들'에 재교육이라는 조치를 추가
Retraining current employees for new positions within the company will also greatly reduce their fear of being laid off.
직원을 회사 내 새 직무로 재교육하는 것도 해고 두려움을 크게 줄일 것이다.
→ ④ 문장 뒤. 'also'가 앞선 두려움 완화책에 재교육을 더하고, '새 직무 재교육'이 ⑤의 재배치 설명으로 이어짐
앞 문장
but→ 비용 절감 계획도 노사가 함께 해야 한다는 앞의 완화 조치 흐름
( ④) It may be that robots are needed to reduce manufacturing costs so that the company remains competitive, but planning for such cost reductions should be done jointly by labor and management.
회사가 경쟁력을 유지하도록 로봇으로 제조비를 줄여야 할 수도 있지만, 그런 비용 절감 계획은 노사가 공동으로 해야 한다.
→ 넣을 문장 앞. 두려움 완화 조치들의 흐름을 이어 재교육 조치를 받을 자리를 만듦
뒤 문장
Since→ 넣을 문장의 '새 직무로의 재교육/재배치'를 구체적으로 설명(판단이 필요한 자리로 이동)
( ⑤) Since robots are particularly good at highly repetitive simple motions, the replaced human workers should be moved to positions where judgment and decisions beyond the abilities of robots are required.
로봇은 반복적 단순 동작에 특히 능하므로, 대체된 인간 노동자는 로봇 능력을 넘어선 판단과 결정이 필요한 자리로 옮겨져야 한다.
→ 넣을 문장 뒤. '새 직무로 옮김'이 넣을 문장의 '새 직무 재교육'을 부연
→ 정답: ⑤
⑤정답 also=또 다른 두려움 완화책, retraining for new positions가 ⑤의 '재배치'로 이어짐 · ①②③④ 재배치 설명이 아직 없어 지시 대상 부재
🔁재진술 지도 재진술 연결 문제 · 정답 패러프레이징
핵심(A)공장 로봇 도입의 두려움은 경영진의 완화 조치, 특히 재교육으로 줄일 수 있다
같은 소재 A가 A→A′→A″→A‴로 표현만 바뀌며 되풀이 → 마지막이 정답 선지
AIt is the responsibility of management to ... ease these fears경영진이 두려움을 덜어야 함
A′↓추가Retraining current employees for new positions ... will also greatly reduce their fear재교육도 두려움을 줄임
정답'두려움 완화 조치'에 '재교육'을 also로 추가

38문장 삽입 평가원 2023학년도 9월 38번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)가 가리킬 자리와 흐름이 끊긴 곳을 찾으세요.
삽입할 문장In particular, they define a group as two or more people who interact with, and exert mutual influences on, each other.
In everyday life, we tend to see any collection of people as a group. ( ① ) However, social psychologists use this term more precisely. ( ② ) It is this sense of mutual interaction or inter-dependence for a common purpose which distinguishes the members of a group from a mere aggregation of individuals. ( ③ ) For example, as Kenneth Hodge observed, a collection of people who happen to go for a swim after work on the same day each week does not, strictly speaking, constitute a group because these swimmers do not interact with each other in a structured manner. ( ④ ) By contrast, a squad of young competitive swimmers who train every morning before going to school is a group because they not only share a common objective (training for competition) but also interact with each other in formal ways (e.g., by warming up together beforehand). ( ⑤ ) It is this sense of people coming together to achieve a common objective that defines a “team”.
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
① ) However, social psychologists use this term② ) It is this sense of mutual interaction or③ ) For example, as Kenneth Hodge observed,④ ) By contrast,⑤ ) It is this sense of people coming together
🔗 연결고리 단서
지시어 they·this역접 However논리 공백
✅ 셀프 체크
  • 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)를 확인했나?
  • 그 선행어가 있는 위치 뒤인가?
  • 넣으니 흐름 단절이 메워지나?
✍️ 내 풀이

내가 고른 답

💡 문장 삽입 팁

핵심 소재·주장(A)은 주어져 있다. 지문에서 그것을 다른 말로 바꾼 표현을 나온 만큼 A′→A″…로 찾아 잇는다. 실제 재진술만 — 없으면 잇지 않는다.

38문장 삽입 평가원 2022학년도 6월 38번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)가 가리킬 자리와 흐름이 끊긴 곳을 찾으세요.
삽입할 문장A problem, however, is that supervisors often work in locations apart from their employees and therefore are not able to observe their subordinates’ performance.
In most organizations, the employee’s immediate supervisor evaluates the employee’s performance. (①) This is because the supervisor is responsible for the employee’s performance, providing supervision, handing out assignments, and developing the employee. (②) Should supervisors rate employees on performance dimensions they cannot observe? (③) To eliminate this dilemma, more and more organizations are implementing assessments referred to as 360-degree evaluations. (④) Employees are rated not only by their supervisors but by coworkers, clients or citizens, professionals in other agencies with whom they work, and subordinates. (⑤) The reason for this approach is that often coworkers and clients or citizens have a greater opportunity to observe an employee’s performance and are in a better position to evaluate many performance dimensions.
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
① ) This is because② ) Should supervisors rate employees on③ ) To④ ) Employees are rated not only by their supervisors but⑤ ) The
🔗 연결고리 단서
지시어 they·this역접 However논리 공백
✅ 셀프 체크
  • 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)를 확인했나?
  • 그 선행어가 있는 위치 뒤인가?
  • 넣으니 흐름 단절이 메워지나?

이는 상사가 직원의 성과에 책임이 있으며 감독·업무 배정·육성을 하기 때문이다.

삽입할 문장As long as the irrealism of the silent black and white film predominated, one could not take filmic fantasies for representations of reality.
Cinema is valuable not for its ability to make visible the hidden outlines of our reality, but for its ability to reveal what reality itself veils ― the dimension of fantasy. ( ①) This is why, to a person, the first great theorists of film decried the introduction of sound and other technical innovations (such as color) that pushed film in the direction of realism. ( ②) Since cinema was an entirely fantasmatic art, these innovations were completely unnecessary. ( ③) And what’s worse, they could do nothing but turn filmmakers and audiences away from the fantasmatic dimension of cinema, potentially transforming film into a mere delivery device for representations of reality. ( ④) But sound and color threatened to create just such an illusion, thereby destroying the very essence of film art. ( ⑤) As Rudolf Arnheim puts it, “The creative power of the artist can only come into play where reality and the medium of representation do not coincide.”

As long as the irrealism of the silent black and white film predominated, one could not take filmic fantasies for representations of reality.

(④) But sound and color threatened to create just such an illusion, thereby destroying the very essence of film art.

삽입할 문장As a result, they are fit and grow better, but they aren’t particularly long-lived.
When trees grow together, nutrients and water can be optimally divided among them all so that each tree can grow into the best tree it can be. If you “help” individual trees by getting rid of their supposed competition, the remaining trees are bereft. They send messages out to their neighbors unsuccessfully, because nothing remains but stumps. Every tree now grows on its own, giving rise to great differences in productivity. (①) Some individuals photosynthesize like mad until sugar positively bubbles along their trunk. (②) This is because a tree can be only as strong as the forest that surrounds it. (③) And there are now a lot of losers in the forest. (④) Weaker members, who would once have been supported by the stronger ones, suddenly fall behind. (⑤) Whether the reason for their decline is their location and lack of nutrients, a passing sickness, or genetic makeup, they now fall prey to insects and fungi.

삽입할 문장On top of the hurdles introduced in accessing his or her money, if a suspected fraud is detected, the account holder has to deal with the phone call asking if he or she made the suspicious transactions.
Each new wave of technology is intended to enhance user convenience, as well as improve security, but sometimes these do not necessarily go hand-in-hand. For example, the transition from magnetic stripe to embedded chip slightly slowed down transactions, sometimes frustrating customers in a hurry. ( ①) Make a service too burdensome, and the potential customer will go elsewhere. ( ②) This obstacle applies at several levels. ( ③) Passwords, double-key identification, and biometrics such as fingerprint-, iris-, and voice recognition are all ways of keeping the account details hidden from potential fraudsters, of keeping your data dark. ( ④) But they all inevitably add a burden to the use of the account. ( ⑤) This is all useful at some level ― indeed, it can be reassuring knowing that your bank is keeping alert to protect you ― but it becomes tiresome if too many such calls are received.

39문장 삽입 3점평가원 2024학년도 수능 39번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)가 가리킬 자리와 흐름이 끊긴 곳을 찾으세요.
삽입할 문장A favorable mutation is going to be more heavily represented in the next generation, since the organism in which it occurred will have more offspring and mutations are transmitted to the offspring.
At the next step in the argument, however, the analogy breaks down. Misprints in a book or in any written message usually have a negative impact on the content, sometimes (literally) fatally. The displacement of a comma, for instance, may be a matter of life and death. Similarly most mutations have harmful consequences for the organism in which they occur, meaning that they reduce its reproductive fitness. Occasionally, however, a mutation may occur that increases the fitness of the organism, just as an accidental failure to reproduce the text of the first edition might provide more accurate or updated information. By contrast, there is no mechanism by which a book that accidentally corrects the mistakes of the first edition will tend to sell better.
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

삽입할 문장A favorable mutation is going to be more heavily represented in the next generation, since the organism in which it occurred will have more offspring and mutations are transmitted to the offspring.
At the next step in the argument, however, the analogy breaks down. Misprints in a book or in any written message usually have a negative impact on the content, sometimes (literally) fatally. The displacement of a comma, for instance, may be a matter of life and death. Similarly most mutations have harmful consequences for the organism in which they occur, meaning that they reduce its reproductive fitness. Occasionally, however, a mutation may occur that increases the fitness of the organism, just as an accidental failure to reproduce the text of the first edition might provide more accurate or updated information. By contrast, there is no mechanism by which a book that accidentally corrects the mistakes of the first edition will tend to sell better.
🔗 연결고리로 넣을 자리를 찾는 과정 (노랑 형광펜이 아니라 지시어·연결어·시간으로 조각을 연결)
A favorable mutation지시어주어진 문장 'A favorable mutation'은 ③의 'a mutation may occur that increases the fitness'(유리한 돌연변이)를 받음 — ③ 뒤여야 함
a mutation may occur that increases the fitness대응·반복③ 문장 — 유리한 돌연변이 도입, 주어진 문장이 이를 이어받아 '다음 세대에 더 많이 대표됨'을 설명
By contrast, there is no mechanism연결어⑤의 'By contrast'가 주어진 문장(유리한 돌연변이는 확산)과 '책의 오류 정정은 그런 기제가 없다'를 대조 — 주어진 문장 뒤여야 대조 성립

  2. 2주어진 문장: 'A favorable mutation'이 이를 받아 '자손이 많아 다음 세대에 더 많이 대표됨'
  3. 3⑤: 'By contrast'로 '책의 우연한 오류 정정에는 그런 확산 기제가 없다'를 대조 → ④에 삽입
→ 정답: ④

⑤⑤ By contrast / (책 비교로 이미 넘어감)✘ 없음

39문장 삽입STEP 3 · 해석 (조각 잇기)🔗 지시어·이음매
🔗 조각별 해석 — 넣을 문장의 지시어가 앞을 받아 끊긴 흐름을 메우는지 확인
넣을 문장
A favorable mutation→ 앞 문장의 '유기체의 적합도를 높이는 (유리한) 돌연변이'를 되받음
A favorable mutation is going to be more heavily represented in the next generation, since the organism in which it occurred will have more offspring and mutations are transmitted to the offspring.
유리한 돌연변이는 다음 세대에 더 많이 대표되는데, 그 돌연변이가 일어난 개체가 더 많은 자손을 갖고 돌연변이는 자손에게 전달되기 때문이다.
→ 앞 문장(유리한 돌연변이 도입) 뒤. 'A favorable mutation'이 앞을 받아 '다음 세대에 확산'으로 이음
앞 문장
however→ 바로 앞의 '대부분의 돌연변이는 해롭다'와 대조
Occasionally, however, a mutation may occur that increases the fitness of the organism, just as an accidental failure to reproduce the text of the first edition might provide more accurate or updated information.
그러나 이따금, 유기체의 적합도를 높이는 돌연변이가 발생할 수 있는데, 이는 초판 텍스트를 우연히 잘못 재현한 것이 더 정확하거나 갱신된 정보를 제공할 수 있는 것과 같다.
→ 넣을 문장 앞. 여기서 '유리한 돌연변이'를 처음 도입해 넣을 문장이 받을 대상을 만듦
뒤 문장
By contrast→ 넣을 문장의 '유리한 돌연변이는 다음 세대에 확산된다'와 대조 (책의 오류 정정에는 그런 기제가 없음)
By contrast, there is no mechanism by which a book that accidentally corrects the mistakes of the first edition will tend to sell better.
그에 반해, 초판의 실수를 우연히 바로잡은 책이 더 잘 팔리게 되는 기제는 존재하지 않는다.
→ 넣을 문장 뒤. 'By contrast'가 앞의 확산 기제와 대조돼 삽입이 완성됨
→ 정답: ④
④정답 '적응도 높이는 돌연변이'(③) 뒤에서 'A favorable mutation'이 이어지고 ⑤ By contrast가 대조를 이룸 · ①②③엔 '유리한 돌연변이'가 아직 없음 · ⑤는 이미 책 대조로 넘어간 자리

핵심(A)적응도를 높이는 돌연변이는 곧 유리한 돌연변이다

🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)가 가리킬 자리와 흐름이 끊긴 곳을 찾으세요.
삽입할 문장If not, the robot might endlessly chase itself rather than the blocks.
People involved in the conception and engineering of robots designed to perceive and act know how fundamental is the ability to discriminate oneself from other entities in the environment. Without such an ability, no goal-oriented action would be possible. ( ①) Imagine that you have to build a robot able to search for blocks scattered in a room in order to pile them. ( ②) Even this simple task would require that your machine be able to discriminate between stimulation that originates from its own machinery and stimulation that originates from the blocks in the environment. ( ③) Suppose that you equip your robot with an artificial eye and an artificial arm to detect, grab, and pile the blocks. ( ④) To be successful, your machine will have to have some built-in system enabling it to discriminate between the detection of a block and the detection of its own arm. ( ⑤) Your robot would engage in circular, self-centered acts that would drive it away from the target or external goal.
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

삽입할 문장Here the lexicon seems in keeping with pictorial practices and coloring techniques.
For thousands of years in the West, red was the only color worthy of that name, the only true color. As much on the historical as hierarchical level, it exceeded all others. Not that they did not exist, but they had to wait a long time before they were considered colors and then played a comparable role in material culture, social codes, and systems of thought. It was with red that humans did their first color experiments, achieved their first successes, and then constructed a chromatic universe. In certain languages, the same word can mean “red” or simply “colored,” depending on the context, such as coloratus in classical Latin or colorado in modern Castilian. In other languages, the words meaning “red” and “beautiful” share a common root; for example, that is the case in Russian, in which the terms krasnyy (red) and krasivy (beautiful) belong to the same lexical family.

39문장 삽입STEP 2 · 훈련 (연결고리 잇기)평가원 2027학년도 6월 39번 · #179
지시어연결어시간·순서 만 표시 — 노랑 형광펜은 쓰지 않아요
삽입할 문장Here the lexicon seems in keeping with pictorial practices and coloring techniques.
For thousands of years in the West, red was the only color worthy of that name, the only true color. As much on the historical as hierarchical level, it exceeded all others. Not that they did not exist, but they had to wait a long time before they were considered colors and then played a comparable role in material culture, social codes, and systems of thought. It was with red that humans did their first color experiments, achieved their first successes, and then constructed a chromatic universe. In certain languages, the same word can mean “red” or simply “colored,” depending on the context, such as coloratus in classical Latin or colorado in modern Castilian. In other languages, the words meaning “red” and “beautiful” share a common root; for example, that is the case in Russian, in which the terms krasnyy (red) and krasivy (beautiful) belong to the same lexical family.

[삽입문] Researchers are studying how our everyday physical experiences in the world contribute to our understanding of mathematical concepts. (①) The experience of walking along a path, for example, can be a metaphor for thinking about arithmetic. (②) The path starts at some point 0 and as children walk along, every step takes them 1 unit further from the starting point; they can even take half steps or skip along two steps at a time. (③) If they want to imagine what it might mean to add 5 and 9, they could think of first walking 9 steps and then walking 5 more. (④) But that also helps them think about what 14－3 might mean because they can imagine walking backwards. (⑤) If they close their eyes, they might even imagine the shape of the path, the smell of the trees, and the sound that is made when they step on the dried leaves.

삽입할 문장There’s a reason for that: traditionally, park designers attempted to create such a feeling by planting tall trees at park boundaries, building stone walls, and constructing other means of partition.
Parks take the shape demanded by the cultural concerns of their time. Once parks are in place, they are no inert stage ― their purposes and meanings are made and remade by planners and by park users. Moments of park creation are particularly telling, however, for they reveal and actualize ideas about nature and its relationship to urban society. ( ①) Indeed, what distinguishes a park from the broader category of public space is the representation of nature that parks are meant to embody. ( ②) Public spaces include parks, concrete plazas, sidewalks, even indoor atriums. ( ③) Parks typically have trees, grass, and other plants as their central features. ( ④) When entering a city park, people often imagine a sharp separation from streets, cars, and buildings. ( ⑤) What’s behind this idea is not only landscape architects’ desire to design aesthetically suggestive park spaces, but a much longer history of Western thought that envisions cities and nature as antithetical spaces and oppositional forces.

삽입할 문장Another approach is to vary the number of ways that the principle may be applied.
It may be easier to reach an agreement when settlement terms don’t have to be implemented until months in the future. Negotiators should try to find ways to slice a large issue into smaller pieces, known as using salami tactics. ( ① ) Issues that can be expressed in quantitative, measurable units are easy to slice. ( ② ) For example, compensation demands can be divided into cents-per-hour increments or lease rates can be quoted as dollars per square foot. ( ③ ) When working to fractionate issues of principle or precedent, parties may use the time horizon (when the principle goes into effect or how long it will last) as a way to fractionate the issue. ( ④ ) ( ⑤ ) For example, a company may devise a family emergency leave plan that allows employees the opportunity to be away from the company for a period of no longer than three hours, and no more than once a month, for illness in the employee’s immediate family.
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

38문장 삽입 평가원 2024학년도 9월 38번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)가 가리킬 자리와 흐름이 끊긴 곳을 찾으세요.
삽입할 문장Because the manipulation of digitally converted sounds meant the reprogramming of binary information, editing operations could be performed with millisecond precision.
The shift from analog to digital technology significantly influenced how music was produced. First and foremost, the digitization of sounds ― that is, their conversion into numbers ― enabled music makers to undo what was done. ( ①) One could, in other words, twist and bend sounds toward something new without sacrificing the original version. ( ②) This “undo” ability made mistakes considerably less momentous, sparking the creative process and encouraging a generally more experimental mindset. ( ③) In addition, digitally converted sounds could be manipulated simply by programming digital messages rather than using physical tools, simplifying the editing process significantly. ( ④) For example, while editing once involved razor blades to physically cut and splice audiotapes, it now involved the cursor and mouse-click of the computer-based sequencer program, which was obviously less time consuming. ( ⑤) This microlevel access at once made it easier to conceal any traces of manipulations (such as joining tracks in silent spots) and introduced new possibilities for manipulating sounds in audible and experimental ways.
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
① ) One② )③ ) In addition, digitally converted④ ) For example, while editing⑤ ) This microlevel access at once made

🔗 조각별 해석 — 넣을 문장의 지시어가 앞을 받아 끊긴 흐름을 메우는지 확인
넣을 문장
editing operations could be performed with millisecond precision→ 디지털 편집이 '2진 정보 재프로그래밍'이어서 밀리초 단위 정밀 편집이 가능해짐 — 뒤 문장이 받을 'microlevel access'를 만듦
Because the manipulation of digitally converted sounds meant the reprogramming of binary information, editing operations could be performed with millisecond precision.
디지털 변환음의 조작은 2진 정보의 재프로그래밍을 의미했기에, 편집 작업은 밀리초 단위 정밀도로 수행될 수 있었다.
→ ④(커서·마우스 편집 예시) 뒤, ⑤ 앞. '밀리초 정밀도'를 도입해 ⑤가 받게 함
앞 문장
For example→ ③의 '디지털 메시지 프로그래밍으로 편집 단순화'의 구체 예 (면도날 대신 커서·마우스)
For example, while editing once involved razor blades to physically cut and splice audiotapes, it now involved the cursor and mouse-click of the computer-based sequencer program, which was obviously less time consuming.
예컨대 예전엔 면도날로 테이프를 잘라 이었지만 이제는 커서와 마우스 클릭으로 하게 되어 훨씬 시간이 덜 든다.
→ 넣을 문장 앞. 디지털 편집의 구체 예를 제시해 넣을 문장의 '밀리초 정밀'로 이어짐
뒤 문장
This microlevel access→ 넣을 문장의 '밀리초 단위 정밀 편집(millisecond precision)' — 그 미시적 접근을 받음
This microlevel access at once made it easier to conceal any traces of manipulations (such as joining tracks in silent spots) and introduced new possibilities for manipulating sounds.
이 미시적 접근은 조작의 흔적을 감추기 쉽게 만들고 새로운 조작 가능성을 열었다.
→ 넣을 문장 뒤. 'This microlevel access'가 '밀리초 정밀'을 받아야 지칭이 성립 → ⑤
→ 정답: ⑤

삽입할 문장But many other contests have multiple parts, and the number of such contests may be increasing.
Science is sometimes described as a winner-take-all contest, meaning that there are no rewards for being second or third. This is an extreme view of the nature of scientific contests. (①) Even those who describe scientific contests in such a way note that it is a somewhat inaccurate description, given that replication and verification have social value and are common in science. (②) It is also inaccurate to the extent that it suggests that only a handful of contests exist. (③) (④) By way of example, for many years it was thought that there would be “one” cure for cancer, but it is now realized that cancer takes multiple forms and that multiple approaches are needed to provide a cure. (⑤) There won’t be one winner ― there will be many.
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

삽입할 문장But many other contests have multiple parts, and the number of such contests may be increasing.
Science is sometimes described as a winner-take-all contest, meaning that there are no rewards for being second or third. This is an extreme view of the nature of scientific contests. (①) Even those who describe scientific contests in such a way note that it is a somewhat inaccurate description, given that replication and verification have social value and are common in science. (②) It is also inaccurate to the extent that it suggests that only a handful of contests exist. (③) (④) By way of example, for many years it was thought that there would be “one” cure for cancer, but it is now realized that cancer takes multiple forms and that multiple approaches are needed to provide a cure. (⑤) There won’t be one winner ― there will be many.
🔗 연결고리로 넣을 자리를 찾는 과정 (노랑 형광펜이 아니라 지시어·연결어·시간으로 조각을 연결)

  2. 2주어진 문장 'But many other contests...'가 '소수(a handful)'를 역접으로 뒤집어 '여러 부분을 가진 경쟁이 많다'고 제시 → ③
  3. 3④의 'By way of example' 암 치료(여러 접근 필요) 사례가 이를 예시로 뒷받침

넣을 문장
But→ 앞 문장의 '소수의 경쟁만 존재한다'는 주장 (이를 역접으로 뒤집음)
But many other contests have multiple parts, and the number of such contests may be increasing.
그러나 다른 많은 경쟁들은 여러 부분으로 이루어져 있으며, 그런 경쟁의 수는 늘어나고 있을지도 모른다.

첫머리 단서 없음
It is also inaccurate to the extent that it suggests that only a handful of contests exist.
그것은 또한 소수의 경쟁만이 존재한다고 시사하는 한에서도 부정확하다.

뒤 문장
By way of example→ 넣을 문장의 '여러 부분을 가진 경쟁이 많다'는 진술 (그 구체 예시)
By way of example, for many years it was thought that there would be “one” cure for cancer, but it is now realized that cancer takes multiple forms and that multiple approaches are needed to provide a cure.
예를 들어, 여러 해 동안 암에 대한 “하나의” 치료법이 있으리라 여겨졌지만, 이제는 암이 여러 형태를 띠며 치료를 위해 여러 접근이 필요하다는 것이 깨달아지고 있다.

→ 정답: ③

삽입할 문장Continuous emissions measurement can be costly, particularly where there are many separate sources of emissions, and for many pollution problems this may be a major disincentive to direct taxation of emissions.
Environmental taxes based directly on measured emissions can, in principle, be very precisely targeted to the policy’s environmental objectives. (①) If a firm pollutes more, it pays additional tax directly in proportion to the rise in emissions. (②) The polluter thus has an incentive to reduce emissions in any manner that is less costly per unit of abatement than the tax on each unit of residual emissions. (③) The great attraction of basing the tax directly on measured emissions is that the actions the polluter can take to reduce tax liability are actions that also reduce emissions. (④) Nevertheless, the technologies available for monitoring the concentrations and flows of particular substances in waste discharges have been developing rapidly. (⑤) In the future, it may be possible to think of taxing measured emissions in a wider range of applications.

The great attraction→ 측정에 직접 기반한 과세의 장점
The great attraction of basing the tax directly on measured emissions is that the actions the polluter can take to reduce tax liability are actions that also reduce emissions.
측정된 배출에 직접 과세하는 것의 큰 매력은, 오염원이 세 부담을 줄이려 취하는 행동이 곧 배출을 줄이는 행동이라는 점이다.

삽입할 문장It signals to them that it is time to lose their leaves.
As winter approaches, the length of the day shortens, the temperature drops, and plants, including trees, can detect this change. It is worth pointing out that leaves don’t drop to the ground because they are dying ― rather, the tree initiates an active process of clever recycling called senescence. A tree, like an oak for example, would struggle to survive through a harsh winter if it retained its canopy of leaves. ( ①) It would risk damage from strong winter winds and would lose more water from its leaves than it could draw up from the frozen ground. ( ②) If it didn’t blow over, it would die of thirst. ( ③) ( ④) First, however, trees carefully suck all of the useful nutrients out of the leaves and then, with surgical precision, block up that pathway into the leaves. ( ⑤) That blocked pathway at the base of the leaf stem creates a weakness and, in the wind, the leaves snap off and fall to the ground.

38문장 삽입 평가원 2027학년도 6월 38번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)가 가리킬 자리와 흐름이 끊긴 곳을 찾으세요.
삽입할 문장To minimize vortex shedding, skyscraper designers do everything in their powers to confuse the wind.
To minimize building costs and maximize revenues, skyscrapers generally take the shape of squares or rectangles. These are not particularly aerodynamic shapes, and this results in a wind phenomenon called “vortex shedding.” As wind meets a rectangular skyscraper it pushes on the flat face of the building before flowing around its sides, where eventually it separates from the face of the structure. ( ① ) The difference in pressures on the front and back faces of the building gives rise to vortices, or spinning currents of wind, that flow downstream from the building. ( ② ) The vortices pull and push the building in a direction perpendicular to the wind at frequencies that can become dangerously self-sustaining. ( ③ ) Orienting the building so that the longer face of the structure is parallel with prevailing winds can help. ( ④ ) Chopping or rounding off corners of a building can likewise make it more aerodynamic. ( ⑤ ) Roughing up the corners of the building through the careful placement of balconies or stepped corners can help by disturbing or delaying the formation of strong vortices.
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

바람이 직사각형 초고층 건물과 만나면, 건물의 평평한 면을 밀친 뒤 양옆으로 흘러가고, 결국 구조물의 면에서 떨어져 나간다.

39문장 삽입 3점평가원 2023학년도 6월 39번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)가 가리킬 자리와 흐름이 끊긴 곳을 찾으세요.
삽입할 문장This makes sense from the perspective of information reliability.
The dynamics of collective detection have an interesting feature. Which cue(s) do individuals use as evidence of predator attack? In some cases, when an individual detects a predator, its best response is to seek shelter. ( ①) Departure from the group may signal danger to nonvigilant animals and cause what appears to be a coordinated flushing of prey from the area. ( ②) Studies on dark-eyed juncos support the view that nonvigilant animals attend to departures of individual group mates but that the departure of multiple individuals causes a greater escape response. [삽입문] ( ③) If one group member departs, it might have done so for a number of reasons that have little to do with predation threat. ( ④) If nonvigilant animals escaped each time a single member left the group, they would frequently respond when there was no predator (a false alarm). ( ⑤) On the other hand, when several individuals depart the group at the same time, a true threat is much more likely to be present.
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
① ) Departure② ) Studies on dark-eyed juncos (a type of③ ) If one group member departs,④ ) If nonvigilant animals escaped⑤ ) On the other hand, when several individuals

38문장 삽입 2점평가원 2024학년도 6월 38번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)가 가리킬 자리와 흐름이 끊긴 곳을 찾으세요.
삽입할 문장Instead, much like the young child learning how to play ‘nicely’, the apprentice scientist gains his or her understanding of the moral values inherent in the role by absorption from their colleagues ― socialization.
As particular practices are repeated over time and become more widely shared, the values that they embody are reinforced and reproduced and we speak of them as becoming ‘institutionalized’. ( ①) In some cases, this institutionalization has a formal face to it, with rules and protocols written down, and specialized roles created to ensure that procedures are followed correctly. ( ②) The main institutions of state ― parliament, courts, police and so on ― along with certain of the professions, exhibit this formal character. ( ③) Other social institutions, perhaps the majority, are not like this; science is an example. ( ④) Although scientists are trained in the substantive content of their discipline, they are not formally instructed in ‘how to be a good scientist’. ( ⑤) We think that these values, along with the values that inform many of the professions, are under threat, just as the value of the professions themselves is under threat.
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
① ) In some cases, this institutionalization② ) The main institutions of state ―③ ) Other④ ) Although scientists are trained⑤ ) We

39문장 삽입 평가원 2024학년도 9월 39번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)가 가리킬 자리와 흐름이 끊긴 곳을 찾으세요.
삽입할 문장In the case of specialists such as art critics, a deeper familiarity with materials and techniques is often useful in reaching an informed judgement about a work.
Acknowledging the making of artworks does not require a detailed, technical knowledge of, say, how painters mix different kinds of paint, or how an image editing tool works. (①) All that is required is a general sense of a significant difference between working with paints and working with an imaging application. (②) This sense might involve a basic familiarity with paints and paintbrushes as well as a basic familiarity with how we use computers, perhaps including how we use consumer imaging apps. (③) This is because every kind of artistic material or tool comes with its own challenges and affordances for artistic creation. (④) Critics are often interested in the ways artists exploit different kinds of materials and tools for particular artistic effect. (⑤) They are also interested in the success of an artist’s attempt ― embodied in the artwork itself ― to push the limits of what can be achieved with certain materials and tools.
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)가 가리킬 자리와 흐름이 끊긴 곳을 찾으세요.
삽입할 문장This active involvement provides a basis for depth of aesthetic processing and reflection on the meaning of the work.
There are interesting trade-offs in the relative importance of subject matter (i.e., figure) and style (i.e., background). ( ①) In highly representational paintings, plays, or stories, the focus is on subject matter that resembles everyday life and the role of background style is to facilitate the construction of mental models. ( ②) Feelings of pleasure and uncertainty carry the viewer along to the conclusion of the piece. ( ③) In highly expressionist works, novel stylistic devices work in an inharmonious manner against the subject matter thereby creating a disquieting atmosphere. ( ④) Thus, when the work is less “readable” (or easily interpreted), its departure from conventional forms reminds the viewer or reader that an “aesthetic attitude” is needed to appreciate the whole episode. ( ⑤) An ability to switch between the “pragmatic attitude” of everyday life and an “aesthetic attitude” is fundamental to a balanced life.

🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)가 가리킬 자리와 흐름이 끊긴 곳을 찾으세요.
삽입할 문장Unfortunately, at the scales, accuracy, and precision most useful to protected area management, the future not only promises to be unprecedented, but it also promises to be unpredictable.
To decide whether and how to intervene in ecosystems, protected area managers normally need a reasonably clear idea of what future ecosystems would be like if they did not intervene. ( ①) Management practices usually involve defining a more desirable future condition and implementing management actions designed to push or guide ecosystems toward that condition. ( ②) Managers need confidence in the likely outcomes of their interventions. ( ③) This traditional and inherently logical approach requires a high degree of predictive ability, and predictions must be developed at appropriate spatial and temporal scales, often localized and near-term. ( ④) To illustrate this, consider the uncertainties involved in predicting climatic changes, how ecosystems are likely to respond to climatic changes, and the likely efficacy of actions that might be taken to counter adverse effects of climatic changes. ( ⑤) Comparable uncertainties surround the nature and magnitude of future changes in other ecosystem stressors.
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
① ) Management② ) Managers need confidence in the③ ) This traditional④ ) To illustrate this, consider the uncertainties⑤ ) Comparable uncertainties surround

39문장 삽입STEP 2 · 훈련 (연결고리 잇기)평가원 2025학년도 9월 39번 · #192
지시어연결어시간·순서 만 표시 — 노랑 형광펜은 쓰지 않아요
삽입할 문장Unfortunately, at the scales, accuracy, and precision most useful to protected area management, the future not only promises to be unprecedented, but it also promises to be unpredictable.
To decide whether and how to intervene in ecosystems, protected area managers normally need a reasonably clear idea of what future ecosystems would be like if they did not intervene. ( ①) Management practices usually involve defining a more desirable future condition and implementing management actions designed to push or guide ecosystems toward that condition. ( ②) Managers need confidence in the likely outcomes of their interventions. ( ③) This traditional and inherently logical approach requires a high degree of predictive ability, and predictions must be developed at appropriate spatial and temporal scales, often localized and near-term. ( ④) To illustrate this, consider the uncertainties involved in predicting climatic changes, how ecosystems are likely to respond to climatic changes, and the likely efficacy of actions that might be taken to counter adverse effects of climatic changes. ( ⑤) Comparable uncertainties surround the nature and magnitude of future changes in other ecosystem stressors.
🔗 연결고리로 넣을 자리를 찾는 과정 (노랑 형광펜이 아니라 지시어·연결어·시간으로 조각을 연결)
Unfortunately연결어넣을 문장이 앞의 '예측 능력이 필요하다'는 논리를 뒤집어 '미래는 예측 불가'를 제시 → 예측 능력 요구 문장(③) 뒤
at the scales, accuracy, and precision대응·반복앞 문장의 'appropriate spatial and temporal scales'를 받아 바로 그 규모에서 예측이 불가함을 말함
To illustrate this지시어'this'가 넣을 문장의 '예측 불가능성'을 가리킴 → 넣을 문장 뒤
Comparable uncertainties대응·반복넣을 문장이 연 '불확실성' 논의가 다른 스트레스 요인으로 확장되며 마무리
  1. 1③ 문장: 전통적 접근은 적절한 규모에서 높은 예측 능력을 요구한다고 제시
  2. 2넣을 문장: 'Unfortunately'와 'at the scales'로 반전해 바로 그 규모에서 미래가 예측 불가함을 말함
  3. 3④ 뒤 문장: 'To illustrate this'로 그 예측 불가능성을 기후 변화 불확실성으로 예시 → ④에 삽입
→ 정답: ④
순서·삽입은 '중요 문장'이 아니라 이어주는 단서(고리)로 푼다.
①①✘ 연결 어긋남
②②✘ 연결 어긋남
③③✘ 연결 어긋남
④④✔ 근거
⑤⑤✘ 연결 어긋남

39문장 삽입STEP 3 · 해석 (조각 잇기)🔗 지시어·이음매
🔗 조각별 해석 — 넣을 문장의 지시어가 앞을 받아 끊긴 흐름을 메우는지 확인
넣을 문장
Unfortunately→ 앞 문장의 '예측 능력이 필요하다'는 전통적 접근
Unfortunately, at the scales, accuracy, and precision most useful to protected area management, the future not only promises to be unprecedented, but it also promises to be unpredictable.
안타깝게도, 보호구역 관리에 가장 유용한 규모·정확도·정밀도에서 미래는 전례 없을 뿐 아니라 예측 불가능하기도 하다.
→ 앞 문장(예측 능력 필요) 뒤. 'Unfortunately'가 그 요구를 뒤집어 '예측 불가'를 제시
앞 문장
This traditional ... approach→ 관리가 예측 능력을 요구한다는 전통적 접근
This traditional and inherently logical approach requires a high degree of predictive ability, and predictions must be developed at appropriate spatial and temporal scales, often localized and near-term.
이 전통적이고 본질적으로 논리적인 접근은 높은 예측 능력을 요구하며, 예측은 적절한 공간적·시간적 규모에서, 흔히 국지적·단기적으로 이루어져야 한다.
→ 넣을 문장 앞. '적절한 규모에서의 예측'을 요구해 넣을 문장의 'at the scales'가 받을 대상을 만듦
뒤 문장
To illustrate this→ 넣을 문장의 '미래는 예측 불가능하다'는 진술
To illustrate this, consider the uncertainties involved in predicting climatic changes, how ecosystems are likely to respond to climatic changes ...
이를 예시하기 위해, 기후 변화 예측, 생태계의 반응, 대응 조치의 효과에 얽힌 불확실성을 생각해 보라.
→ 넣을 문장 뒤. 'this'가 넣을 문장의 예측 불가능성을 받아 기후 불확실성으로 예시
→ 정답: ④
④정답 '예측 능력 필요'(③) 뒤 'Unfortunately ... 미래는 예측 불가'가 반전으로 오고 'To illustrate this'가 그 불확실성을 예시 · ①②③⑤ 'this'가 받을 예측 불가 진술이 없음
🔁재진술 지도 재진술 연결 문제 · 정답 패러프레이징
핵심(A)관리에 필요한 미래 예측은 그 규모에서 오히려 불가능하다
같은 소재 A가 A→A′→A″→A‴로 표현만 바뀌며 되풀이 → 마지막이 정답 선지
AThis traditional ... approach requires a high degree of predictive ability높은 예측 능력이 필요
A′↓역접the future ... promises to be unpredictable그러나 미래는 예측 불가

38문장 삽입 평가원 2025학년도 수능 38번STEP 1 · 직접 풀기 ✍️
🔗 연결고리로 푼다 — 주어진 문장의 지시어(this·they)가 가리킬 자리와 흐름이 끊긴 곳을 찾으세요.
삽입할 문장Without any special legal protection for trade secrets, however, the secretive inventor risks that an employee or contractor will disclose the proprietary information.
Trade secret law aims to promote innovation, although it accomplishes this objective in a very different manner than patent protection. ( ①) Notwithstanding the advantages of obtaining a patent, many innovators prefer to protect their innovation through secrecy. ( ②) They may believe that the cost and delay of seeking a patent are too great or that secrecy better protects their investment and increases their profit. ( ③) They might also believe that the invention can best be utilized over a longer period of time than a patent would allow. ( ④) Once the idea is released, it will be “free as the air” under the background norms of a free market economy. ( ⑤) Such a predicament would lead any inventor seeking to rely upon secrecy to spend an inordinate amount of resources building high and impassable fences around their research facilities and greatly limiting the number of people with access to the proprietary information.
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

🔗 연결고리로 넣을 자리를 찾는 과정 (노랑 형광펜이 아니라 지시어·연결어·시간으로 조각을 연결)
